words.en: A collaborative piece of work is done by two or more people or groups working together.

words.ex: He will defer his trip until next month.
words.ex_cn: 他将把旅行推迟到下个月。
words.en: If you defer an event or action, you arrange for it to happen at a later date, rather than immediately or at the previously planned time.

words.tr: v. 较喜欢；更喜欢；宁愿；
words.ex: I prefer tea to coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you prefer someone or something, you like that person or thing better than another, and so you are more likely to choose them if there is a choice.

words.ex: The teacher spoke in a comprehensible way.
words.ex_cn: 老师用容易理解的方式讲话。
words.en: If something is comprehensible, you can understand it.

words.ex: He is diligent in doing his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都很勤奋地做作业。
words.en: Someone who is diligent works hard and is careful and thorough.

words.ex: The teacher will enlighten the students about the truth.
words.ex_cn: 老师将向学生们阐明真相。
words.en: To enlighten someone means to give them more knowledge and greater understanding about something.

words.tr:
n. 狂乱；狂暴；狂怒
v. 使狂乱；使狂怒
words.ex: The crowd went into a frenzy when the singer appeared.
words.ex_cn: 当歌手出现时，人群陷入了狂热。
words.en: A frenzy is a state of uncontrolled excitement or wild behavior.

words.tr: adj. 不同寻常的；非凡的；显著的；值得注意的；
words.ex: She made a remarkable improvement in just one month.
words.ex_cn: 她在短短一个月内取得了不同寻常的进步。
words.en: Unusual or striking in a way that attracts attention.

words.tr:
v. 派遣；调遣；发送
n. 快信；发送；派遣
words.ex: He will dispatch the package tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会寄出这个包裹。
words.en: To send someone or something to a particular place for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The radioactive material glows in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 这种放射性物质在黑暗中发光。
words.en: Something that is radioactive contains a substance that produces energy in the form of powerful and harmful rays.

words.ex: The injury incapacitated him for weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这次受伤使他几周无法行动。
words.en: To make someone unable to do something, especially because of injury or illness.

words.ex: Bananas have a lot of potassium.
words.ex_cn: 香蕉含有大量的钾。
words.en: A soft silver-white reactive metal of the alkali metal group, occurring principally in the form of salts in seawater and in minerals such as sylvite and carnallite.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.tr: adj. 造成严重后果的； v. “cripple”的现在分词；
words.ex: The earthquake caused crippling damage to the city.
words.ex_cn: 地震给这座城市造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: Causing severe damage or impairment, often leading to a state of being unable to function effectively.

words.tr:
n. 纸片；
v. 滑倒；溜走；
words.ex: She found a slip of paper on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌子上发现了一张纸片。
words.en: If you slip, you accidentally slide and lose your balance.

words.tr: adj. 即将发生的；迫在眉睫的； v. “impend”的现在分词；
words.ex: An impending storm made people stay indoors.
words.ex_cn: 一场即将发生的风暴让人们待在室内。
words.en: If an event or situation is impending, it is about to happen or is likely to happen very soon.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.ex: She added pepper to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加了胡椒粉。
words.en: Pepper is a hot-tasting powder made from the crushed seeds of certain plants, used to flavor food.

words.ex: The bison walks slowly across the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 野牛慢慢地走过草原。
words.en: A bison is a large, wild animal that is related to the cow and is native to North America and Europe. Bison have a large head, a humped back, and are covered with thick, shaggy hair.

words.ex: Can you tell me the gist of the story?
words.ex_cn: 你能告诉我这个故事的要点吗？
words.en: The main or essential part of a matter.

words.ex: It is a hypothetical situation.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个假设的情况。
words.en: A hypothetical situation, idea, or explanation is based on possible ideas or situations rather than actual ones.

words.tr: adj. 解释性的；说明性的；例证性的
words.ex: This example is illustrative of the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这个例子说明了这个问题。
words.en: Serving as an example or explanation.

words.tr: adj. 明白易懂的；表达清楚的
words.ex: The instructions were written in a perspicuous manner.
words.ex_cn: 说明书写得清晰易懂。
words.en: If you describe something such as an argument or explanation as perspicuous, you mean that it is clear and easy to understand.

words.tr:
v. 做实习生；扣留
n. 实习生
words.ex: He is interning at a hospital this summer.
words.ex_cn: 他今年夏天在医院做实习生。
words.en: An intern is someone who works in a temporary position with an emphasis on on-the-job training rather than merely employment, often to gain experience in a particular field.

words.tr: adj. 严格的；缜密的；严密的；
words.ex: The teacher is rigorous about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 老师对作业截止日期要求严格。
words.en: If you are rigorous in something, you are very thorough and strict in the way you do it.

words.ex: The stone skimmed over the water.
words.ex_cn: 石头掠过水面。
words.en: To remove a substance from the surface of a liquid, or to read or consider something quickly in order to understand the main points, without studying it in detail.

words.ex: He stood on the podium to receive the gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 他站在领奖台上领取金牌。
words.en: A podium is a small platform on which someone stands to give a speech or conduct an orchestra, or on which a medal winner stands during a prize-giving ceremony.

words.ex: His opinion is subordinate to the manager's.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见比经理的次要。
words.en: If someone is your subordinate, they have a less important position than you in the organization that you both work for.

words.tr:
v. 交换；
n. 交换；
words.ex: They swap books every week.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周交换书籍。
words.en: If you swap something with someone, you give it to them and receive a different thing in exchange.

words.ex: The lab technician transcribes the DNA sequence into RNA.
words.ex_cn: 实验室技术员将DNA序列转录成RNA。
words.en: To transcribe something means to write it down or to copy it from one form of recording to another.

words.ex: The old abbey stands on a hill near the village.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的修道院坐落在村庄附近的山上。
words.en: A complex of buildings housing a monastery or convent, typically including a church, living quarters, and other facilities.

words.tr:
n. 击球员；
v. 连续猛击；
words.ex: The batter hit a home run in the ninth inning.
words.ex_cn: 击球员在第九局击出了全垒打。
words.en: To batter something means to hit it hard many times, often causing a lot of damage. In sports, a batter is the player who is trying to hit the ball in games like baseball or cricket. Batter can also refer to a mixture of flour, eggs, and milk or water, used to make pancakes or to coat food before frying.

words.tr: n. 着陆；降落；楼梯平台； v. “land”的现在分词；
words.ex: The plane made a smooth landing at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在机场平稳着陆。
words.en: The act of coming to or bringing something to land, especially an aircraft.

words.ex: The teacher gave us the syllabus for the course.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们这门课的教学大纲。
words.en: A syllabus is an outline or summary of the main points of a text, lecture, or course of study.

words.tr:
v. 吹嘘；自吹自擂
adj. 一流的；极好的
words.ex: He brags about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他炫耀自己的新车。
words.en: If you brag, you say in a very proud way that you have something or have done something.

words.tr:
v. 行屈膝礼
n. （女子行的）屈膝礼
words.ex: The girl made a curtsy to the queen.
words.ex_cn: 女孩向女王行了个屈膝礼。
words.en: A curtsy is a formal greeting made by a woman, in which she bends her knees with one foot in front of the other.

words.ex: They had a feast on New Year's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他们在元旦举办了一场盛宴。
words.en: A feast is a large and special meal, often to celebrate something.

words.ex: The hikers walked through a deep gorge.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者走过一个深峡谷。
words.en: A gorge is a deep, narrow valley with steep sides, often carved by a river. It can also refer to the act of eating greedily.

words.tr:
v. 大步走；大步跑
n. 大步慢跑；平稳、轻松的步伐
words.ex: The deer loped gracefully through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 鹿优雅地大步慢跑穿过森林。
words.en: To run or move with a long, easy stride.

words.tr: v. 使系统化；使成体系；使条理化
words.ex: He tries to systematize his notes before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前试图系统化他的笔记。
words.en: To systematize means to arrange according to an organized system; make systematic.

words.ex: Please don't disturb me while I'm reading.
words.ex_cn: 我读书时请不要打扰我。
words.en: To disturb someone means to interrupt what they are doing and cause them inconvenience or annoyance.

words.ex: He put the letter in an envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把信装进了一个信封。
words.en: An envelope is a flat, usually rectangular or square, paper container for a letter, which you seal before you send it by post.

words.ex: The teacher monitors the students' progress each week.
words.ex_cn: 老师每周监控学生的进步。
words.en: A monitor is a machine that is used to check or record things, for example in a factory or hospital. In a school, a monitor is a student who helps the teacher with various duties.

words.ex: He will submit his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会提交他的作业。
words.en: To yield or surrender (oneself) to the will or authority of another.

words.tr: n. 上腭；味觉；审美眼光；嗜好；爱好
words.ex: The roof of the mouth is called the palate.
words.ex_cn: 口腔的顶部被称为上腭。
words.en: The palate refers to the roof of the mouth in humans and other mammals, separating the oral cavity from the nasal cavity. It also refers to a person's ability to distinguish between and appreciate different flavors.

words.ex: I managed to finish my homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我设法在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: To manage means to be in charge of or control something, especially a business or a group of people.

words.tr:
n. 争吵
v. 争吵
words.ex: The two boys squabble over toys every day.
words.ex_cn: 这两个男孩每天为玩具争吵。
words.en: A squabble is a noisy disagreement about something unimportant.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.tr: adj. 兼容的；可和谐共存的；
words.ex: This printer is compatible with my computer.
words.ex_cn: 这个打印机与我的电脑兼容。
words.en: If things, for example, systems, ideas, and beliefs, are compatible, they work well together or can exist together successfully.

words.ex: The team showed unity in winning the match.
words.ex_cn: 团队在赢得比赛时展现了统一。
words.en: Unity refers to the state of being united or joined as a whole.

words.ex: The parliament passed a new law about education.
words.ex_cn: 国会通过了一项关于教育的新法律。
words.en: A parliament is a legislative body of government, typically composed of elected representatives, that is responsible for making laws and representing the interests of the people.

words.ex: It was a mere mistake, not intentional.
words.ex_cn: 那只是一个小小的错误，并非故意的。
words.en: You use mere to emphasize how unimportant or inadequate something is, in comparison to the general situation you are describing.

words.ex: The bees built a hive in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在树上建了一个蜂巢。
words.en: A hive is a structure where bees live, consisting of a series of cells in which they store honey and raise their young.

words.tr: v. 诱惑；引诱；怂恿；劝诱；
words.ex: The smell of cookies tempted him to eat one.
words.ex_cn: 饼干的香味诱惑他吃了一块。
words.en: If something tempts you, it makes you want to have it or do it, even though you know you should not.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.ex: The river flows through a deep ravine.
words.ex_cn: 河流流经一个深谷。
words.en: A ravine is a deep, narrow gorge with steep sides, often carved by a river or stream.

words.ex: The meteorologist predicts rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 气象学家预测明天会下雨。
words.en: A meteorologist is a scientist who studies the atmosphere and its phenomena, especially in relation to weather and weather forecasting.

words.ex: He chose teaching as his vocation.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了教学作为自己的职业。
words.en: A vocation is a type of work that you feel you are especially suited to do and to which you give much of your time and energy.

words.ex: The small plant grew in a crevice of the rock.
words.ex_cn: 这棵小植物长在岩石的裂隙里。
words.en: A crevice is a narrow crack or gap, especially in a rock.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.ex: He won the spelling contest.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了拼写比赛。
words.en: A contest is a competition or a struggle for victory between individuals or groups.

words.ex: I recognize her face from school.
words.ex_cn: 我从学校认出了她的脸。
words.en: If you recognize someone or something, you know who or what they are because you have seen or heard them before.

words.tr:
v. 分开；分裂；
n. 划分；分歧；
words.ex: The tree split in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 那棵树在风暴中裂开了。
words.en: If something splits or if you split it, it is divided into two or more parts.

words.ex: Wear a helmet to counteract the risk of head injury.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔以对抗头部受伤的风险。
words.en: If you counteract something, you reduce its effect by doing something that produces an opposite effect.

words.ex: The validity of the test results is important.
words.ex_cn: 测试结果的有效性很重要。
words.en: The quality of being logically or factually sound; soundness or cogency.

words.ex: He picked up the receiver to answer the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起听筒接电话。
words.en: A receiver is a person who receives something or a device that receives signals and converts them into sound or pictures.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The wound caused a serious infection.
words.ex_cn: 伤口引起了严重的感染。
words.en: An infection is a disease caused by microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, or parasites invading the body.

words.ex: The bomb left a deep crater in the road.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹在道路上炸出了一个深深的弹坑。
words.en: A crater is a large hole in the ground, typically caused by an explosion or the impact of a meteorite.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.tr:
n. 袭击；罢工；
v. 击打；侵袭；突然想到；
words.ex: The strike on the base happened at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 对基地的袭击发生在黎明时分。
words.en: To hit someone or something forcefully; to stop work as a form of protest.

words.ex: He ate a chunk of cheese for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一大块奶酪。
words.en: A chunk of something is a large piece or amount of it.

words.ex: The scientist examined the fluid-filled sac under the microscope.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在显微镜下观察了充满液体的囊。
words.en: A sac is a bag-like structure in an animal or plant, often filled with fluid.

words.tr:
n. 抓痕；刮伤；
v. 抓搔；刮；
words.ex: The cat left a scratch on the door.
words.ex_cn: 猫在门上抓出了一道抓痕。
words.en: If you scratch something, you rub your fingernails or claws against it, often because it is itchy or irritating.

words.ex: He got a vaccine last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周打了疫苗。
words.en: A vaccine is a substance containing a virus or bacterium in a form that is not harmful, given to a person or animal to prevent them from getting the disease that the virus or bacterium causes.

words.tr: adj. 最高的；至上的；最重要的；
words.ex: His safety is paramount.
words.ex_cn: 他的安全是最重要的。
words.en: Something that is paramount or of paramount importance is more important than anything else.

words.ex: This is the latest version of the app.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个应用的最新版本。
words.en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

words.ex: The painting has a simple aesthetic appeal.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有一种简单的审美吸引力。
words.en: Concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty.

words.tr: n. 地方主义；方言；偏狭性
words.ex: The author's use of provincialism adds authenticity to the story.
words.ex_cn: 作者使用方言增加了故事的真实性。
words.en: Provincialism refers to the attitudes, practices, and other characteristics of a province or of someone from a province, often implying a lack of sophistication or a narrow-minded perspective.

words.ex: The price rose sharply last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月价格急剧上涨。
words.en: In a sharp manner; with a sharp edge or point; abruptly; severely.

words.ex: Europeans colonized many parts of Africa in the 1800s.
words.ex_cn: 欧洲人在19世纪开拓了非洲的许多地区。
words.en: To colonize means to send people to live in and govern another country.

words.tr: adj. 外界的；外在的；非固有的；
words.ex: The reward was extrinsic, not from within.
words.ex_cn: 这个奖励是外界的，不是来自内心的。
words.en: Extrinsic means not forming part of or belonging to a thing; external.

words.ex: The manager will authorize the payment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 经理明天将批准这笔付款。
words.en: To give official permission for something to happen, or to give someone official permission to do something.

words.tr: n. 差额；边缘；净利润；余地；
words.ex: The profit margin is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 利润差额是五美元。
words.en: The margin is the edge or border of something, or the difference between two amounts, especially the difference between the cost of producing something and the price it is sold for.

words.ex: The disadvantage of living far away is long commute time.
words.ex_cn: 住得远的劣势是通勤时间长。
words.en: A disadvantage is a factor which makes someone or something less useful, acceptable, or successful than other people or things.

words.ex: The farm has a surplus of apples this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年农场苹果过剩。
words.en: A surplus is an amount of something that is extra or more than what is needed.

words.ex: The two notes sound harmonic together.
words.ex_cn: 这两个音听起来很和谐。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by harmony; pleasing to the ear; melodious.

words.ex: Saturn has beautiful rings around it.
words.ex_cn: 土星周围有美丽的光环。
words.en: Saturn is the sixth planet from the Sun in the Solar System and is known for its prominent ring system, which is composed mainly of ice particles with a smaller amount of rocky debris and dust.

words.ex: The room has good acoustic properties.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有良好的声音效果。
words.en: Relating to sound or the sense of hearing.

words.ex: He tried to disprove the theory with new data.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用新数据驳斥这个理论。
words.en: To disprove something means to show that it is not true or correct.

words.ex: The floor has a colorful mosaic of flowers.
words.ex_cn: 地板上有一个五彩的花卉镶嵌图案。
words.en: A mosaic is a picture or pattern produced by arranging together small colored pieces of hard material, such as stone, tile, or glass.

words.ex: He inserts a coin into the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他把一枚硬币放进机器里。
words.en: To put or introduce something into something else.

words.tr:
adj. 疏远的；冷淡的
adv. 远离地
words.ex: He stayed aloof during the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上保持冷淡。
words.en: Someone who is aloof is not very friendly and does not like to spend time with other people.

words.ex: The game simulates real traffic conditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏模拟了真实的交通状况。
words.en: To simulate is to create a model or representation of a situation, process, or system for the purpose of study, analysis, or training. It involves imitating the conditions of a real event or environment to understand its effects or to practice responses to it.

words.tr: n. 资金；款项；拨款； v. “fund”的现在分词；
words.ex: The school needs more funding for new books.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校需要更多资金来购买新书。
words.en: Funding is money which is used to pay for a particular activity or to help achieve a particular purpose.

words.ex: His speech was persuasive and made everyone agree.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲很有说服力，让所有人都同意了。
words.en: A persuasive argument or reason is one that makes you believe that something is true or right.

words.ex: The rain rendered the road slippery.
words.ex_cn: 雨水使道路变得滑溜。
words.en: To render something means to cause it to become or to provide it. It can also mean to express or translate something.

words.ex: He caught influenza last winter.
words.ex_cn: 他去年冬天得了流感。
words.en: Influenza is an infectious disease caused by the influenza virus, characterized by fever, sore throat, muscle pain, severe headache, coughing, and weakness.

words.tr: adj. 先进的；高级的； v. 提前；前进；“advance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This school uses advanced technology in classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在教室里使用先进的技术。
words.en: An advanced system, method, or design is modern and has been developed from an earlier version of the same thing.

words.tr: n. 毁灭；引起毁灭的根源；
words.ex: The storm caused the destruction of the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴摧毁了村庄。
words.en: The act of destroying something, or the state of being destroyed.

words.ex: The trucks stop at the depot to load goods.
words.ex_cn: 卡车在仓库停靠以装载货物。
words.en: A depot is a place where large amounts of raw materials, manufactured goods, or equipment are stored until they are needed.

words.ex: He gave her a romantic gift on Valentine's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他在情人节送了她一份浪漫的礼物。
words.en: If you describe something as romantic, you mean that it is connected with love or with a feeling of excitement and mystery associated with love.

words.tr: n. 大亨；巨头；大企业家；
words.ex: He became a tycoon after building a big oil company.
words.ex_cn: 他在建立了一家大型石油公司后成为了一位大亨。
words.en: A tycoon is a person who is successful in business or industry and has become rich and powerful.

words.ex: The judge made a fair decision to show justice.
words.ex_cn: 法官做出了公正的裁决以体现公正。
words.en: Justice is fairness in the way that people are treated.

words.tr: n. 专家咨询组；嵌板；仪器板；
words.ex: The government formed a panel to advise on health policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府组建了一个专家咨询组来就卫生政策提供建议。
words.en: A panel is a small group of people who are chosen to do something, for example to discuss something in public or to make a decision.

words.ex: He felt guilty for lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对朋友撒谎而感到有罪。
words.en: If you feel guilty, you feel unhappy because you believe that you have done something wrong or have failed to do something which you should have done.

words.ex: He tried to decipher the secret code.
words.ex_cn: 他试图破译那个秘密代码。
words.en: To decipher something means to convert it from a code into normal language or to understand something that is difficult to understand or that is not obvious.

words.ex: She put a cushion on the chair to make it comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个靠垫，让它更舒服。
words.en: A cushion is a soft bag of some ornamental material, stuffed with wool, hair, feathers, polyester staple fiber, non-woven material, or even paper torn into fragments. It may be used for sitting or kneeling upon, or to soften the hardness or angularity of a chair or couch.

words.ex: A microorganism can cause sickness.
words.ex_cn: 微生物会导致疾病。
words.en: A microorganism is a very small living thing that you can only see with a microscope.

words.tr:
adj. 糟糕的；可怕的；
adv. 非常；极其；
words.ex: The weather today is awful.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很糟糕。
words.en: If you say that something is awful, you mean that it is extremely unpleasant, shocking, or bad.

words.ex: He needs surgery for his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要做手术来治疗断掉的胳膊。
words.en: Surgery is the medical specialty that uses operative manual and instrumental techniques on a patient to investigate or treat a pathological condition such as a disease or injury, to help improve bodily function or appearance, or to repair unwanted ruptured areas.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.tr:
n. 甲壳动物
adj. 甲壳类的
words.ex: The crab is a crustacean.
words.ex_cn: 螃蟹是一种甲壳类动物。
words.en: A crustacean is a type of animal with a hard shell, such as a crab or lobster.

words.ex: He obtained a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周获得了一份新工作。
words.en: If you obtain something, you get it or achieve it.

words.ex: The respondent answered all the questions honestly.
words.ex_cn: 这位调查对象诚实地回答了所有问题。
words.en: A respondent is someone who replies to something such as a survey or set of questions.

words.tr:
adj. 特指的；特殊的；挑剔的；
n. 细节；详情；
words.ex: He wants a particular book, not any other.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一本特指的书，不是别的。
words.en: You use particular to emphasize that you are talking about one thing or one kind of thing rather than other similar ones.

words.tr: n. 新闻纸；白报纸；报纸上的文字；（印刷报纸的）油墨
words.ex: He prints the poster on newsprint.
words.ex_cn: 他把海报印在新闻纸上。
words.en: Newsprint is the cheap, low-quality paper on which newspapers are printed.

words.ex: Dolphins are gregarious animals that swim in groups.
words.ex_cn: 海豚是群居动物，成群游泳。
words.en: Someone who is gregarious enjoys being with other people.

words.tr:
v. 摩擦；擦痛；惹怒
n. 擦伤；激怒
words.ex: His socks chafe his ankles.
words.ex_cn: 他的袜子磨得脚踝疼。
words.en: If skin chafes, it becomes sore because something is rubbing against it; to feel impatient or irritated.

words.ex: The lizard sits on the rock in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 蜥蜴趴在阳光下的石头上。
words.en: A lizard is a reptile with a long body, four legs, a long tail, and rough, scaly skin.

words.ex: He spoke in a polite manner.
words.ex_cn: 他以礼貌的方式说话。
words.en: The way in which something is done or happens.

words.tr: n. 人工制品；手工艺品；加工品
words.ex: The museum has an ancient artifact.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一件古代文物。
words.en: An artifact is an object that is made by a person, especially something of historical or cultural interest.

words.ex: She wears a necklace made of crystal.
words.ex_cn: 她戴一条水晶制成的项链。
words.en: A crystal is a solid that has a regular, repeating arrangement of atoms. Crystals are often transparent and can be used in jewelry or as decorative objects.

words.ex: The children played on the gravel path.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在砾石小路上玩耍。
words.en: Gravel consists of very small stones. It is often used to make paths and roads.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.ex: He saw a beautiful panorama from the mountain top.
words.ex_cn: 他从山顶看到了美丽的全景。
words.en: A panorama is a view of a wide area, or a description or study that presents all the different parts or aspects of a particular subject.

words.ex: Her talent is unparalleled.
words.ex_cn: 她的才华是无比的。
words.en: Having no parallel or equal; unmatched.

words.tr: v. 暂停；中止；延期； suspending
words.ex: The school will suspend the class due to snow.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雪，学校将暂停课程。
words.en: If you suspend something, you delay it or stop it from happening for a while or until a decision is made about it.

words.ex: The disease afflicted many people in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病使村子里许多人遭受痛苦。
words.en: If you are afflicted by pain, illness, or misfortune, it causes you great suffering and distress.

words.ex: The tiger has black stripes on its orange fur.
words.ex_cn: 老虎的橙色皮毛上有黑色条纹。
words.en: A stripe is a long, narrow band or strip differing in color or texture from the surface on either side of it.

words.ex: The potter shaped the clay into a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把黏土塑造成一个碗。
words.en: Clay is a type of fine-grained natural soil material that contains hydrous aluminium phyllosilicates (clay minerals) that develops plasticity when wet.

words.tr:
v. 评论；表达意见；
n. 评论；意见；
words.ex: He commented on the movie last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚对这部电影发表了评论。
words.en: A comment is something that you say which expresses your opinion of something or which gives an explanation of it.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.ex: He planted carrots in a small patch.
words.ex_cn: 他在一小块地上种了胡萝卜。
words.en: A patch is a piece of material used to mend a hole or a weak spot in something, or a small area that is different from the area around it.

words.ex: The law restricts driving after drinking.
words.ex_cn: 法律限制酒后驾驶。
words.en: to limit the movements or actions of someone, or to limit something and reduce its size or prevent it from increasing

words.ex: The clock shows accurate time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟显示的时间很精确。
words.en: Correct in all details; exact.

words.ex: The team comprises five players and one coach.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队包括五名球员和一名教练。
words.en: If you say that something comprises or is comprised of a number of things or people, you mean it has them as its parts or members.

words.ex: The enzyme helps break down food in the stomach.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶帮助分解胃里的食物。
words.en: An enzyme is a protein that acts as a catalyst to bring about a specific biochemical reaction.

words.ex: The king ate a sumptuous meal in his palace.
words.ex_cn: 国王在他的宫殿里享用了一顿丰盛的饭菜。
words.en: Something that is sumptuous is very impressive and expensive, especially in a way that involves large amounts of money.

words.ex: He swore allegiance to his country.
words.ex_cn: 他向自己的国家宣誓效忠。
words.en: Loyalty or commitment to a superior or to a group or cause.

words.ex: The invasion of privacy is a serious problem.
words.ex_cn: 侵犯隐私是一个严重的问题。
words.en: An invasion is an instance of invading a country or region with an armed force.

words.ex: He kept the dishes in the cabinet.
words.ex_cn: 他把盘子放在储藏柜里。
words.en: A cabinet is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves or drawers, used for storing or showing things. In politics, a cabinet is a group of people who are chosen by a head of state to give advice and to help set government policy.

words.ex: The bird hovers above the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 鸟在花上空盘旋。
words.en: To remain in one place in the air, or to stay close to someone or something.

words.ex: The accuracy of the clock is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟的精确性很高。
words.en: The quality or state of being correct or precise.

words.ex: My passport will expire next month.
words.ex_cn: 我的护照下个月到期。
words.en: If something such as a contract or a visa expires, it comes to an end or is no longer valid.

words.ex: He buys gasoline for his car every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周为他的汽车买汽油。
words.en: Gasoline is a volatile, flammable liquid obtained from petroleum and used as fuel in internal combustion engines.

words.ex: The noise will diminish after midnight.
words.ex_cn: 午夜后噪音会减少。
words.en: If something diminishes, or if something diminishes it, it becomes reduced in size, importance, or intensity.

words.tr: adj. 角的；有角的；尖角的；
words.ex: The angular shape of the triangle is clear.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的角形很清晰。
words.en: having angles or sharp corners; lean and bony

words.ex: The mountain is immense.
words.ex_cn: 这座山非常巨大。
words.en: Extremely large or great, especially in scale or degree.

words.ex: The owl sleeps in the tree during the day.
words.ex_cn: 猫头鹰白天在树上睡觉。
words.en: An owl is a bird with a flat face, large eyes, and a small sharp beak. Most owls hunt at night.

words.ex: He plays the drum, a type of percussion.
words.ex_cn: 他演奏鼓，一种打击乐器。
words.en: Percussion refers to musical instruments that are played by being struck or shaken, such as drums, cymbals, or tambourines. It can also refer to the act of striking or hitting something.

words.tr:
adj. 弯曲的；扭曲的；欺诈的；不老实的
v. （使）弯曲；使成钩状；“crook”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The path was crooked and hard to walk on.
words.ex_cn: 这条路是弯曲的，很难走。
words.en: If you describe something as crooked, especially something that is usually straight, you mean that it is bent or twisted.

words.tr: n. 岩层；地层；社会阶层
words.ex: The geologist examined the stratum for fossils.
words.ex_cn: 地质学家检查了岩层以寻找化石。
words.en: A stratum is a layer of material, naturally or artificially formed, often one of a number of parallel layers one upon another.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you do one thing instead of another, you do the first thing and not the second thing, especially as the result of a choice or a change of behaviour.

words.tr: v. 居住于；生活于；移民于
words.ex: Many people populate this small town.
words.ex_cn: 许多人居住在这个小镇上。
words.en: To populate an area means to live in it or to fill it with people or things.

words.ex: He is an ambitious student who wants to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有雄心的学生，想成为一名医生。
words.en: Having or showing a strong desire and determination to succeed.

words.tr: adj. 感伤的；感情的；多愁善感的
words.ex: He kept the old toy because he was sentimental about it.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了那个旧玩具，因为他对它有感情。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as sentimental, you mean that they are influenced by emotional feelings, especially about happy memories of past events or relationships with other people, rather than by careful thought and judgment based on facts.

words.tr: adj. 最终的；最后的；极端的；
words.ex: This is the ultimate solution to the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个问题的最终解决方案。
words.en: You use ultimate to describe the final result or aim of a long series of events.

words.tr:
adj. 常绿的；常青的；
n. 常绿树；常绿植物；
words.ex: The evergreen trees stay green all year.
words.ex_cn: 常绿树一年四季都是绿色的。
words.en: An evergreen is a plant, tree, or bush that has green leaves all the year round.

words.ex: The bird's plumage was a vibrant mix of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟的羽毛色彩鲜艳。
words.en: The feathers covering the body of a bird.

words.tr: adj. 堕落的；颓废的；衰落的
words.ex: He ate a decadent chocolate cake.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块奢华的巧克力蛋糕。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behavior as decadent, you think that they are morally corrupt or that they are living in an immoral way.

words.ex: This bird is a subspecies of the robin.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟是知更鸟的一个亚种。
words.en: A subspecies is a taxonomic category that ranks below species, usually a fairly permanent geographically isolated race.

words.ex: The hummingbird flies quickly around the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜂鸟快速地在花朵周围飞翔。
words.en: A very small, brightly coloured bird with a long thin beak, whose wings move very fast and make a humming sound.

words.ex: The old estate has large gardens and a beautiful mansion.
words.ex_cn: 这个古老的庄园有大片花园和一座美丽的豪宅。
words.en: An estate is all the money and property that someone owns, especially everything that is left when they die.

words.ex: The stylistic choice of words made the poem more beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 词语的文体选择使这首诗更加优美。
words.en: Relating to the style or manner of something, especially in literature or art.

words.ex: The president will declare a holiday next week.
words.ex_cn: 总统将在下周宣布放假。
words.en: If you declare something, you state it formally, publicly, or officially.

words.tr:
n. 清漆；漆面；光泽面
v. 给…涂上清漆
words.ex: He put varnish on the wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 他在木桌上涂了清漆。
words.en: Varnish is a transparent, hard, protective finish or film primarily used in wood finishing but also for other materials. Varnish is traditionally a combination of a drying oil, a resin, and a thinner or solvent.

words.tr:
v. 想知道；
n. 惊奇；奇迹；
words.ex: I wonder why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想知道他为什么迟到了。
words.en: To feel curiosity or doubt about something; a feeling of surprise mingled with admiration, caused by something beautiful, unexpected, unfamiliar, or inexplicable.

words.ex: He tried to justify his mistake by saying he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他试图以自己累了为由来证明自己的错误是正当的。
words.en: To justify something means to show or prove that it is reasonable, necessary, or correct.

words.ex: Sugar dissolves in water.
words.ex_cn: 糖在水中溶解。
words.en: If a substance dissolves in liquid or if you dissolve a substance, it becomes mixed with the liquid and disappears.

words.ex: His knowledge of history is superficial.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史的了解是表面的。
words.en: If you describe someone as superficial, you disapprove of them because they do not think deeply, and have little understanding of anything serious or important.

words.ex: The peninsula is surrounded by water on three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个半岛三面环水。
words.en: A peninsula is a piece of land that is almost entirely surrounded by water but is connected to the mainland on one side.

words.ex: She stayed in a luxurious hotel with gold faucets.
words.ex_cn: 她住进了一家有金色水龙头的奢侈酒店。
words.en: Something that is luxurious is very comfortable and expensive, and often involves great pleasure or indulgence.

words.ex: The ornate ceiling had gold patterns and flowers.
words.ex_cn: 华丽的天花板上有金色的图案和花朵。
words.en: Something that is ornate is highly decorated with complex patterns.

words.ex: The actor received a plaudit for his performance.
words.ex_cn: 这位演员因他的表演而获得赞誉。
words.en: Plaudit refers to an expression of praise or approval, often given in the form of applause or enthusiastic commendation.

words.tr:
v. 颤抖；颤动；发抖
n. 颤抖
words.ex: The leaf quivers in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在风中颤抖。
words.en: To shake or tremble with a slight rapid motion; a case for carrying arrows.

words.tr:
v. 闲逛；漫步
n. 闲逛；漫步
words.ex: We decided to saunter along the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们决定沿着海滩漫步。
words.en: If you saunter somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.

words.ex: He will tackle the problem tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会处理这个问题。
words.en: If you tackle a problem or task, you deal with it in a determined way. In sports such as football and rugby, a tackle is an act of trying to take the ball from a player on the other team.

words.tr:
n. 带位员；接待员；门房
v. 引领；招待；做招待员
words.ex: The usher showed us to our seats in the theater.
words.ex_cn: 带位员带我们到了剧院的座位。
words.en: An usher is someone who shows people where to sit, especially at a formal event such as a wedding or a concert. As a verb, to usher means to show someone where to go or to lead them somewhere.

words.ex: He runs with great vigour every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都充满精力地跑步。
words.en: Physical or mental strength and energy.

words.ex: He enjoys solitude in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在森林中独处。
words.en: The state or situation of being alone.

words.ex: He bought the car on a whim.
words.ex_cn: 他一时兴起买了这辆车。
words.en: A whim is a sudden desire or change of mind, especially one that is unusual or unexplained.

words.ex: The lab has a new apparatus for measuring temperature.
words.ex_cn: 实验室有一台新的温度测量装置。
words.en: The complex structure of a particular system or organization, or the equipment used for a specific purpose.

words.ex: Blue jeans are in vogue this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年牛仔裤很时髦。
words.en: If something is in vogue, it is very popular and fashionable.

words.tr:
n. 支撑物；支架；牙箍
v. 支撑；绷紧；紧靠；准备好
words.ex: The old bookshelf needs a brace to stay steady.
words.ex_cn: 旧书架需要一个支撑物来保持稳定。
words.en: To brace oneself means to prepare oneself for something difficult or unpleasant.

words.tr:
n. 审查员；检查员
v. 检查；审查
words.ex: The censor removed the bad words from the movie.
words.ex_cn: 审查员从电影中删除了粗俗用语。
words.en: A censor is a person who supervises conduct and morals: in particular, one who examines books, films, or other material for objectionable matter.

words.ex: Fish respire in water using gills.
words.ex_cn: 鱼用鳃在水中呼吸。
words.en: To breathe; to inhale and exhale air.

words.ex: Biology students learn morphology to study plant shapes.
words.ex_cn: 生物学生学习形态学来研究植物的形状。
words.en: Morphology is the study of the form and structure of organisms or their parts.

words.ex: He is adroit at fixing broken machines.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长修理坏掉的机器。
words.en: Someone who is adroit is quick and skillful in their thoughts, behavior, or actions.

words.ex: The stone is covered with green moss.
words.ex_cn: 石头上覆盖着绿色的苔藓。
words.en: Moss is a small, green plant that grows in damp, shady places, often forming a soft, thick layer on the ground, trees, or rocks.

words.tr:
n. 栖枝；鲈鱼；
v. 栖息；处于（高处）；
words.ex: The bird sat on a perch near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟停在树旁的一根栖枝上。
words.en: A perch is a branch or rod where a bird rests or a high position where someone or something is located. As a verb, it means to rest or be located in a high position.

words.ex: He is the recipient of the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个奖项的接受者。
words.en: A recipient is a person who receives something.

words.tr:
n. 车费；费用；
v. 进展；成功（或不成功等）；
words.ex: The bus fare is two dollars.
words.ex_cn: 公交车费是两美元。
words.en: The fare is the amount of money that you pay for a journey that you make, for example, in a bus, train, or taxi.

words.ex: The sign glows with bright neon light.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志发出明亮的霓虹光。
words.en: A colourless, odourless inert gaseous element occurring in minute amounts in the earth's atmosphere, used in fluorescent lights and illuminated advertising signs.

words.tr: v. 减到最少；使最小化；
words.ex: Try to minimize waste in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 尽量减少厨房里的浪费。
words.en: To minimize something means to reduce it to the smallest possible amount or degree.

words.ex: The smell of bread permeate the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 面包的香味弥漫了整个厨房。
words.en: If something permeates a place, it spreads throughout it.

words.tr:
adj. 期中的
n. 期中考试
words.ex: He is preparing for his midterm exam next week.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为下周的期中考试做准备。
words.en: A midterm is an examination that is given in the middle of a term in a school or college.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.ex: The stomach digests food into nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 胃将食物消化成营养物质。
words.en: To digest means to break down food in the stomach and intestines into substances that can be absorbed by the body. It can also mean to understand or assimilate information. As a noun, it refers to a compilation or summary of information.

words.ex: The pancreas makes insulin to control blood sugar.
words.ex_cn: 胰腺分泌胰岛素来控制血糖。
words.en: The pancreas is a large gland behind the stomach which secretes digestive enzymes into the duodenum. Embedded in the pancreas are the islets of Langerhans, which secrete into the blood the hormones insulin and glucagon.

words.tr:
adj. 哥特的；哥特派的
n. 与哥特人或哥特语有关之物
words.ex: The castle has gothic windows and tall towers.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡有哥特式的窗户和高塔。
words.en: Gothic is used to describe a style of architecture that was common in Western Europe between the 12th and 16th centuries, characterized by pointed arches, ribbed vaults, and flying buttresses.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.ex: The old bike has rust on its chain.
words.ex_cn: 这辆旧自行车的链条上有锈。
words.en: Rust is a reddish-brown substance that forms on the surface of iron or steel when they are exposed to air and moisture, causing them to corrode.

words.ex: His testimony proved the suspect was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 他的证词证明了嫌疑人是无辜的。
words.en: A formal written or spoken statement, especially one given in a court of law.

words.ex: The wick of the candle is burning slowly.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的灯芯正在缓慢燃烧。
words.en: A wick is a piece of string in a candle or lamp that burns to produce light.

words.ex: The flowers will perish if you don't water them.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不给花浇水，它们会死。
words.en: If people or animals perish, they die as a result of very harsh conditions or as the result of an accident.

words.ex: Owls are nocturnal animals.
words.ex_cn: 猫头鹰是夜间活动的动物。
words.en: Nocturnal means happening in the night or active at night.

words.ex: He submitted his application for the job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周提交了那份工作申请。
words.en: An application is a formal request, often written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something. It can also refer to the act of putting something to a special use or purpose, or a program or piece of software designed to perform a specific function.

words.ex: The mountains look distant from here.
words.ex_cn: 从这里看，山显得很远。
words.en: If you describe something as distant, you mean that it is far away in space or time.

words.ex: He drew a pentagon, which is a polygon.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个五边形，它是一个多边形。
words.en: A polygon is a flat shape with three or more straight sides and angles.

words.ex: The teacher chose an arbitrary number to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 老师随意选了一个数字来开始游戏。
words.en: If you describe an action, rule, or decision as arbitrary, you think that it is not based on any principle, plan, or system. It often seems unfair because of this.

words.ex: The cell has a thin membrane.
words.ex_cn: 细胞有一层薄薄的膜。
words.en: A membrane is a thin layer of tissue or material that covers or lines a part of the body, or separates one area from another.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.tr: v. 使安静；安慰；使缓和
words.ex: She sang a song to soothe the baby.
words.ex_cn: 她唱了一首歌来安抚婴儿。
words.en: To soothe someone means to make them feel calmer and less anxious, upset, or angry.

words.tr: adj. 强健的；强壮的；结实的；
words.ex: The dog is robust and runs every day.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗很强健，每天跑步。
words.en: Strong and healthy; vigorous. (of an object) sturdy in construction.

words.tr: adj. 分泌毒液的；有毒的；恶毒的
words.ex: The snake is venomous.
words.ex_cn: 这条蛇是有毒的。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behavior as venomous, you mean that they show great bitterness and anger toward someone.

words.tr: n. 房间；室；腔；大会议室；
words.ex: He sat in the chamber and waited quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在房间里安静地等待。
words.en: A chamber is a large room, especially one that is used for formal or public events.

words.ex: The change is reversible under normal conditions.
words.ex_cn: 在正常条件下，这种变化是可逆的。
words.en: Capable of being reversed; able to return to an original state or condition.

words.ex: The car has a sleek design.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有着流畅的外形。
words.en: Sleek describes something that is smooth, glossy, and streamlined, often implying a sense of elegance and efficiency.

words.ex: The copilot assisted the pilot in navigating the aircraft.
words.ex_cn: 副驾驶员协助飞行员驾驶飞机。
words.en: A copilot is the second pilot in an aircraft, who assists the captain in flying the plane.

words.tr: adj. 触觉的；能触知的；手感好的
words.ex: The child learns through tactile objects like blocks.
words.ex_cn: 孩子通过触觉物体如积木来学习。
words.en: Relating to the sense of touch; perceptible by touch.

words.ex: This apple is a variant of the red delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这种苹果是红富士的一个变体。
words.en: A variant is something that is slightly different from other similar things.

words.ex: The sea was choppy, making it difficult to sail.
words.ex_cn: 海面波涛汹涌，使得航行变得困难。
words.en: If the sea or a river is choppy, the water moves in a lot of small waves because it is windy or because the current is strong.

words.ex: Water is a common solvent for salt.
words.ex_cn: 水是盐的常见溶剂。
words.en: A solvent is a substance that can dissolve other substances, or a person or company that has enough money to pay their debts.

words.ex: Honey is a viscous liquid.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是一种黏稠的液体。
words.en: A viscous liquid is thick and sticky and does not flow easily.

words.ex: The yolk of the egg is yellow.
words.ex_cn: 鸡蛋的蛋黄是黄色的。
words.en: The yellow part in the middle of an egg.

words.ex: The children explored a dark cavern.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们探索了一个黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cavern is a large cave or a large chamber in a cave.

words.tr:
v. 使湿透；浸透
n. 弄湿；浸液
words.ex: The rain drenched his clothes.
words.ex_cn: 雨把他的衣服淋湿了。
words.en: To drench something or someone means to make them completely wet.

words.tr: n. 山崩；塌方；压倒性的胜利
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a landslide.
words.ex_cn: 大雨引发了山体滑坡。
words.en: A landslide is a victory in an election in which a person or political party gets far more votes or seats than their opponents.

words.tr: adj. 相接的；相邻的；接壤的
words.ex: The two countries are contiguous.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家是相邻的。
words.en: Being in contact; touching or next to each other.

words.tr:
n. 旷野地；荒野；高沼
v. （使）停泊；系泊
words.ex: The sheep graze on the moor near the village.
words.ex_cn: 羊在村庄附近的旷野地上吃草。
words.en: A moor is an area of open land, often with poor soil, that is covered with grass, heather, and low bushes. It can also refer to the act of securing a ship or boat to a fixed object or the land.

words.ex: The moon looks like a crescent tonight.
words.ex_cn: 今晚的月亮像一弯新月。
words.en: A crescent is a curved shape that is wider in the middle and pointed at the ends, like the shape of the moon in its first or last quarter.

words.ex: The army launched a missile at the target.
words.ex_cn: 军队向目标发射了一枚导弹。
words.en: A missile is a weapon that is sent through the air and that explodes when it hits the thing it is aimed at.

words.tr:
n. 寿衣；裹尸布；覆盖物
v. 覆盖；遮蔽
words.ex: The body was wrapped in a white shroud.
words.ex_cn: 遗体被裹在一件白色的寿衣里。
words.en: A shroud is a cloth which is used for wrapping a dead body. It can also refer to something that covers, hides, or protects.

words.ex: The children built a mound of sand at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海滩上堆了一个沙土墩。
words.en: A mound is a large pile of earth or stones; it can also refer to the action of piling up earth or stones.

words.ex: He is a creative boy who draws nice pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有创造力的男孩，会画漂亮的画。
words.en: Someone who is creative has the ability to invent and develop original ideas, especially in the arts.

words.ex: He is an eccentric man who wears socks with sandals.
words.ex_cn: 他是个古怪的人，穿着袜子配凉鞋。
words.en: If you say that someone is eccentric, you mean that they behave in a strange way, and have habits or opinions that are different from those of most people.

words.tr: adj. 单独的；独唱的；独奏的；
words.ex: He played a solo guitar piece at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐会上演奏了一首独奏吉他曲。
words.en: A solo is a piece of music or a performance done by one person alone, without any accompaniment.

words.ex: We should conserve water in daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们应在日常生活中节约用水。
words.en: To conserve something means to protect it from harm, loss, or change, especially in order to preserve it for the future.

words.ex: The volume of the box is 10 cubic meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的体积是10立方米。
words.en: A volume is a book, especially one that is part of a series of books. It can also refer to the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, or the level of sound produced by a television, radio, etc.

words.ex: He is a temperate person who never shouts.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个温和的人，从不大喊大叫。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as temperate, you mean that it is calm and reasonable, not extreme or emotional.

words.tr: n. 有价值的人或物；长处；
words.ex: He is an asset to the team because he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有价值的人，因为他工作努力。
words.en: An asset is something valuable that an individual, corporation, or country owns or controls with the expectation that it will provide a future benefit.

words.ex: The hiker stood at the edge of the cliff.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者站在悬崖边上。
words.en: A cliff is a high area of rock with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or a river.

words.tr:
n. 脏乱；杂乱；
v. 弄糟；
words.ex: The room was a mess after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对后房间一片狼藉。
words.en: A mess is a situation that is confused and full of problems, or something that is dirty or untidy.

words.ex: He stayed neutral in the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持中立。
words.en: If you say that someone is neutral, you mean that they do not support or help either side in a disagreement, competition, or war.

words.ex: He abbreviates the word 'example' as 'ex.'.
words.ex_cn: 他把单词 'example' 缩写为 'ex.'。
words.en: To abbreviate something means to make it shorter, especially by using a particular word or phrase to represent it.

words.ex: The children felt delight when they saw the toys.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到玩具时感到高兴。
words.en: Delight is a feeling of very great pleasure.

words.tr:
n. 情节；小块用地；
v. 绘图；
words.ex: The plot of the movie was very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的情节非常精彩。
words.en: A plot is a secret plan by a group of people to do something that is illegal or wrong, especially against a person or a government. It can also refer to the main events of a play, novel, movie, or similar work, devised and presented by the writer as an interrelated sequence. Additionally, a plot can be a small piece of land that is used or intended for a specific purpose.

words.ex: The study of crustal deformation is crucial in understanding tectonic movements.
words.ex_cn: 地壳变形的研究对于理解构造运动至关重要。
words.en: Relating to the crust of the earth or another planet.

words.ex: The glow of the fire warmed the room.
words.ex_cn: 火的炽热温暖了房间。
words.en: If something glows, it produces a dull, steady light.

words.tr:
adj. 难过的；沮丧的；
v. 打乱；使心烦；
words.ex: He felt upset when his dog ran away.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到很难过。
words.en: If you are upset, you are unhappy or disappointed because something unpleasant has happened to you.

words.ex: The teacher asked students to annotate the text with notes.
words.ex_cn: 老师让学生们在文本上做注释。
words.en: To add notes or comments to a text or diagram, providing explanation or criticism.

words.tr:
v. 引起（问题、危险等）；提出；
n. 姿势；
words.ex: Pollution can pose a serious threat to health.
words.ex_cn: 污染可能对健康造成严重威胁。
words.en: If you pose for a photograph or painting, you stay in a particular position so that someone can photograph you or paint you. / To pose a question or problem means to ask it or to present it.

words.ex: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 飓风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.

words.tr: v. 互相作用；互相影响；交流；沟通；
words.ex: The two chemicals interact when mixed.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质混合时会互相作用。
words.en: If people interact with each other, they communicate or work together.

words.tr:
n. 毛孔；小孔
v. 细看；钻研；凝视
words.ex: Sweat comes out through the pores of the skin.
words.ex_cn: 汗水通过皮肤上的毛孔排出。
words.en: A pore is a tiny opening in a surface that allows liquids or gases to pass through. As a verb, to pore means to read or study something very carefully.

words.ex: The clown entertains the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: To entertain someone means to amuse or interest them, for example by telling them stories or jokes, or by playing music for them.

words.tr: adj. 细粒状的；颗粒状的；
words.ex: The sand feels granular between your fingers.
words.ex_cn: 沙子在你手指间感觉是细粒状的。
words.en: Granular things are composed of or resemble grains or particles.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.ex: She threaded a bead onto the string.
words.ex_cn: 她把一颗有孔的小珠穿在绳子上。
words.en: A bead is a small piece of glass, wood, or plastic that is used for decorating clothes or making jewellery.

words.ex: The craftsman made a wooden chair by hand.
words.ex_cn: 这位工匠手工制作了一把木椅。
words.en: A craftsman is a skilled worker who makes things by hand.

words.tr:
v. 领会；抓紧；
n. 领会；
words.ex: I couldn't grasp the meaning of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 我没能领会这首诗的含义。
words.en: To grasp something means to take it in your hand and hold it firmly.

words.ex: The teacher showed a bias for students who arrived early.
words.ex_cn: 老师对早到的学生有偏爱。
words.en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result.

words.ex: The old woman predict rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人预言明天会下雨。
words.en: If you predict an event, you say that it will happen.

words.ex: The triangle has three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条边。
words.en: A triangle is a shape consisting of three straight lines and three angles.

words.ex: The outcome of the game was a tie.
words.ex_cn: 比赛的结果是平局。
words.en: The outcome of an activity, process, or situation is the situation that exists at the end of it.

words.ex: We decorate the room for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们为派对装饰房间。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.tr: adj. 松散的；疏松的；未固结的
words.ex: The soil in this area is unconsolidated and prone to landslides.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区的土壤疏松，容易发生滑坡。
words.en: Not yet compacted into a solid mass; loose.

words.ex: The old citadel stands on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 古老的城堡矗立在山上。
words.en: A citadel is a fortress, typically on high ground, protecting or dominating a city.

words.ex: The GPS can pinpoint your exact location.
words.ex_cn: GPS可以精准定位你的准确位置。
words.en: To pinpoint something means to locate or identify it precisely.

words.ex: The bird hatched her eggs after three weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟在三周后孵出了她的蛋。
words.en: To hatch means to cause an egg to break open so that a young animal can come out, or to plan secretly with other people to do something bad or illegal.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: The boy found a fossil in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在岩石中发现了一块化石。
words.en: A fossil is the remains or impression of a prehistoric organism preserved in petrified form or as a mold or cast in rock.

words.ex: He drove on the turnpike to save time.
words.ex_cn: 他走收费公路以节省时间。
words.en: A turnpike is a road that drivers must pay to use, especially in the past. It is also a gate or barrier set across a road to stop traffic until a toll is paid.

words.ex: The error is detectable with a simple test.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误可以通过简单的测试检测出来。
words.en: If something is detectable, it can be noticed or discovered.

words.tr:
n. 对照；反差；对立；
v. 对比；和...形成对照；
words.ex: The contrast between light and dark is clear in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片中明暗的对照很明显。
words.en: A contrast is a great difference between two or more things which is clear when you compare them.

words.ex: The travelers found an oasis with water and trees.
words.ex_cn: 旅行者们发现了一个有水和树木的绿洲。
words.en: An oasis is a small area in a desert where water and plants are found, making it a place of relief and beauty in an otherwise barren landscape.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 首要目标是保持安全。
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.ex: The Gulf of Mexico is a large sea area.
words.ex_cn: 墨西哥湾是一个大型海域。
words.en: A gulf is a large area of sea that is partly surrounded by land.

words.ex: The sky turned pale blue at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时，天空变成了淡蓝色。
words.en: Something that is pale is not strong or bright in color.

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.ex: Eating vegetables is beneficial to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康有益。
words.en: Promoting or enhancing well-being; advantageous.

words.ex: The ball is spherical.
words.ex_cn: 这个球是球状的。
words.en: Something that is spherical is round like a ball.

words.tr:
n. 许可证；
v. 允许；准许；
words.ex: He showed his fishing permit to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 他向官员出示了他的钓鱼许可证。
words.en: If someone permits something, they allow it to happen. If they permit you to do something, they allow you to do it.

words.ex: The addition of a new chair made the room more comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 增加一把新椅子让房间更舒适了。
words.en: An addition is something that is added to something else, often to improve it or make it larger.

words.tr:
n. 离婚；
v. 和…离婚；
words.ex: They filed for divorce after ten years of marriage.
words.ex_cn: 他们结婚十年后申请了离婚。
words.en: Divorce is the formal ending of a marriage by law.

words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.tr: adj. 比喻的；象征的；写实的
words.ex: He used figurative language to describe his feelings.
words.ex_cn: 他用了比喻性的语言来描述他的感受。
words.en: If you use a word or expression in a figurative sense, you use it with a more abstract or imaginative meaning than its ordinary literal one.

words.ex: He painted a portrait of his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅他母亲的肖像。
words.en: A portrait is a painting, drawing, or photograph of a particular person.

words.ex: Carbon dioxide makes the air warm.
words.ex_cn: 二氧化碳使空气变暖。
words.en: A compound containing two atoms of oxygen combined with another element or group.

words.ex: Methanol is commonly used as a solvent in the chemical industry.
words.ex_cn: 甲醇通常用作化学工业中的溶剂。
words.en: Methanol is a colorless, volatile, flammable liquid alcohol used as a solvent, antifreeze, or fuel and in the manufacture of formaldehyde.

words.ex: He amass wealth by working hard.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力工作积累财富。
words.en: If you amass something such as money or information, you gradually collect a large amount of it.

words.ex: It is feasible to finish the project in one week.
words.ex_cn: 一周内完成这个项目是可行的。
words.en: If something is feasible, it can be done, made, or achieved.

words.tr: adj. 令人高兴的； v. “please”的现在分词；
words.ex: The pleasing smell of cookies made her smile.
words.ex_cn: 饼干令人高兴的香味让她笑了。
words.en: Something that is pleasing gives you pleasure or satisfaction.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.ex: He simply wants to go home.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅想回家。
words.en: In a simple manner; without much complexity or difficulty.

words.tr: adj. 肥沃的；有繁殖力的；多产的；富饶的；
words.ex: The fertile land grows many crops.
words.ex_cn: 这片肥沃的土地长满了各种作物。
words.en: Land or soil that is fertile is able to support the growth of a large number of strong healthy plants.

words.ex: His penmanship is very neat.
words.ex_cn: 他的书法非常工整。
words.en: The art or skill of writing by hand.

words.tr: adj. 不确切的；不精确的；
words.ex: His answer was imprecise and confused everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不确切，让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: If you describe something as imprecise, you mean that it is not stated or done accurately or clearly.

words.tr: adj. 小束状的；稀疏的；纤弱的
words.ex: She has wispy hair that floats in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 她有轻盈的头发，在风中飘动。
words.en: Something that is wispy is thin and weak, and often seems to be floating or moving gently.

words.ex: Children are susceptible to colds.
words.ex_cn: 孩子容易感冒。
words.en: If you are susceptible to something or someone, you are very likely to be influenced by them.

words.tr:
n. 方面；尊重；尊敬；
v. 遵从；尊重；尊敬；
words.ex: In this respect, the plan is good.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方面，这个计划很好。
words.en: If you respect someone, you have a good opinion of their character or ideas.

words.tr: n. 废水；污物；水流 adj. 流出的
words.ex: The factory releases effluent into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂将废水排入河中。
words.en: Effluent is liquid waste material that comes out of factories or sewage works.

words.ex: He lost his job because of his integrity.
words.ex_cn: 他因为正直而失去了工作。
words.en: Integrity is the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles.

words.tr:
v. 阻挠；妨碍；挫败
n. 横坐板
words.ex: The rain thwarted our picnic plans.
words.ex_cn: 雨水破坏了我们的野餐计划。
words.en: If you thwart someone or thwart their plans, you prevent them from doing or getting what they want.

words.ex: This is a no-parking zone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个禁止停车的地带。
words.en: An area or a region distinguished from adjacent parts by a distinctive feature or characteristic.

words.ex: She stored jam in a glass jar.
words.ex_cn: 她把果酱存放在一个玻璃罐里。
words.en: A jar is a glass or clay container with a wide opening at the top and a lid, used especially for storing food.

words.ex: He plays the accordion at the street festival.
words.ex_cn: 他在街头音乐节上演奏手风琴。
words.en: An accordion is a musical instrument that you play by pressing keys or buttons on one side and pulling and pushing a bellows on the other side to force air through reeds, producing notes.

words.tr: adj. 死后的；死后出版的；遗腹的
words.ex: He received a posthumous award for his bravery.
words.ex_cn: 他因勇敢而被追授了奖项。
words.en: Posthumous means occurring, awarded, or appearing after the death of the originator.

words.tr:
v. 阻碍；妨碍
n. （带盖）篮子
words.ex: Rain hampered our picnic plans.
words.ex_cn: 雨妨碍了我们的野餐计划。
words.en: If something hampers you, it makes it difficult for you to do something.

words.ex: He adds sodium to his food for taste.
words.ex_cn: 他为了味道在食物里加钠。
words.en: Sodium is a soft, silvery-white, highly reactive metal. Sodium is an alkali metal, being in group 1 of the periodic table, because it has a single electron in its outer shell that it readily donates, creating a positively charged ion—the Na⁺ cation.

words.tr:
adj. 一百年的
n. 百年纪念
words.ex: The city held a centennial parade to celebrate 100 years.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市举行了一场百年游行来庆祝一百周年。
words.en: A centennial is the one-hundredth anniversary of an event, or something that happens every hundred years.

words.tr: adj. 有责任的；负责任的；
words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: If someone or something is responsible for a particular event or situation, they are the cause of it or they can be blamed for it.

words.ex: He watched the whole series of the show.
words.ex_cn: 他看完了这部剧的整个系列。
words.en: A series of things or events is a number of them that come one after the other.

words.ex: The surgeon repaired the torn tendon in the athlete's leg.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了运动员腿上的撕裂肌腱。
words.en: A tendon is a tough band of fibrous connective tissue that usually connects muscle to bone and is capable of withstanding tension.

words.ex: He showed maturity when he apologized for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 当他为自己的错误道歉时，表现出了成熟。
words.en: Maturity is the state of being fully developed or grown, or the time when a financial arrangement becomes ready to be paid.

words.ex: He climbed a big boulder near the river.
words.ex_cn: 他爬上了河边的一块大岩石。
words.en: A boulder is a large rounded rock.

words.ex: He made a careless mistake on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中犯了一个粗心的错误。
words.en: If you are careless, you do not pay enough attention to what you are doing, and so you make mistakes, or cause harm or damage.

words.tr: adj. 贪吃的；贪婪的；如饥似渴的
words.ex: He is a voracious eater who finishes all the food on his plate.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个贪吃的人，总会把盘子里的所有食物吃完。
words.en: If you describe a person or their appetite for something as voracious, you mean that they want a lot of something.

words.ex: Can you clarify your answer?
words.ex_cn: 你能澄清一下你的答案吗？
words.en: To clarify something means to make it easier to understand by explaining it more clearly.

words.tr:
n. 接力赛；轮换者；
v. 传达；传递；
words.ex: The boys ran in the 4x100 meter relay.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们参加了4x100米接力赛。
words.en: A relay is a race between teams in which each team member runs or swims one section of the race. In electronics, a relay is a device that allows a small electrical current to control a larger one.

words.ex: The molten lava flowed down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 熔化的岩浆从山上流下。
words.en: Molten is used to describe substances that have been heated to a very high temperature and have turned into a liquid.

words.tr: adj. 敏锐的；急性的；严重的；
words.ex: He has an acute mind and solves problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他思维敏锐，能快速解决问题。
words.en: An acute problem or negative feeling is very severe.

words.ex: He felt lethargy after eating too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完太多垃圾食品后感到无精打采。
words.en: Lethargy is the condition or state of being lethargic; sluggishness, drowsiness, or apathy.

words.tr: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；
words.ex: The class has diverse students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级有来自许多国家的不同学生。
words.en: If a group or range of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

words.ex: The actor received acclaim for his performance.
words.ex_cn: 这位演员因他的表演而受到赞扬。
words.en: If someone or something is acclaimed, they are praised enthusiastically and publicly.

words.ex: The boy found a meteorite in the field.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在田野里发现了一块陨石。
words.en: A meteorite is a piece of rock or metal that has fallen to the earth's surface from outer space.

words.ex: The consumption of water has increased this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年水的消耗量增加了。
words.en: Consumption is the act of buying and using products.

words.ex: The shrub grows near the fence.
words.ex_cn: 这丛灌木长在篱笆附近。
words.en: A shrub is a woody plant which is smaller than a tree and has several main stems arising at or near the ground.

words.ex: He used the sun to orient himself.
words.ex_cn: 他用太阳来确定方向。
words.en: To orient means to align or position something in relation to the points of a compass or other specified positions, or to familiarize someone with a new situation or environment.

words.tr:
n. 尖塔；尖顶；尖峰；尖岩石；顶点；顶峰
v. 造小尖塔；把...放在极高处
words.ex: The pinnacle of the church reached high into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的尖塔高耸入云。
words.en: The pinnacle of something is the highest point or level that it can reach, especially when it is very good.

words.ex: The desert seems endless.
words.ex_cn: 这片沙漠看起来无穷无尽。
words.en: If you say that something is endless, you mean that it is very large or lasts for a very long time, and it seems as if it will never stop.

words.tr: adj. 寒冷的；冷淡的；性冷淡的（女子）
words.ex: The water is frigid in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天的水很冰冷。
words.en: Frigid means extremely cold in temperature or lacking warmth or enthusiasm.

words.tr:
n. 流体；流质；
adj. 流动的；
words.ex: Water is a common fluid.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的流体。
words.en: A fluid is a substance that can flow and change its shape easily, such as a liquid or a gas.

words.tr:
n. 裂缝；噼啪声；
v. 破裂；
words.ex: There is a small crack in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一条小裂缝。
words.en: If something hard cracks, or if you crack it, it becomes slightly damaged, with lines appearing on its surface.

words.ex: The tectonic plates move slowly over time.
words.ex_cn: 板块随着时间缓慢移动。
words.en: Relating to the structure of the earth's crust and the large-scale processes which take place within it.

words.tr: n. 民主主义者；民主党员；
words.ex: He is a democrat who believes in equal rights for all.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位相信所有人平等权利的民主主义者。
words.en: A democrat is someone who believes in the principles of democracy, such as the idea that everyone should have an equal say in how their country is governed.

words.ex: Clean water is a boon to the village.
words.ex_cn: 干净的水对这个村庄是有益的。
words.en: A boon is something that is very helpful and improves the quality of life.

words.ex: Photodissociation of water molecules is a key process in photosynthesis.
words.ex_cn: 水分子的光离解是光合作用中的一个关键过程。
words.en: The process by which a chemical compound is broken down by photons.

words.ex: She sings as a soprano in the opera choir.
words.ex_cn: 她在歌剧合唱团中担任女高音。
words.en: A soprano is a type of classical female singing voice and has the highest vocal range of all voice types.

words.ex: The troposphere is the lowest layer of the atmosphere.
words.ex_cn: 对流层是大气的最低层。
words.en: The troposphere is the lowest layer of the Earth's atmosphere, extending from the Earth's surface up to about 8 to 15 kilometers high. It is where most weather phenomena occur.

words.tr: adj. 冬天的；寒冷的；冷淡的
words.ex: The landscape was covered in a wintry blanket of snow.
words.ex_cn: 大地被一层冬日的雪毯覆盖。
words.en: Wintry weather is cold and has features that are typical of winter.

words.tr: adj. 有浮力的；心情愉快的；
words.ex: The buoyant life jacket keeps you on the water.
words.ex_cn: 有浮力的救生衣让你浮在水面上。
words.en: A buoyant object floats on a liquid or in the air. A buoyant economy, market, or industry is successful because a lot of money is being spent or invested in it.

words.ex: They used cement to build the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他们用水泥建造了这堵墙。
words.en: Cement is a powdery substance which is mixed with water and used for sticking things together or for making very hard surfaces.

words.ex: He has good spatial skills for drawing maps.
words.ex_cn: 他画地图有很好的空间能力。
words.en: Relating to or occupying space.

words.ex: The dynamical system changes over time.
words.ex_cn: 这个动力系统随时间变化。
words.en: Dynamical is used to describe something that is characterized by constant change, activity, or progress.

words.ex: The company is a legal entity.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司是一个法律实体。
words.en: An entity is something that exists separately from other things and has a clear identity of its own.

words.ex: The fusion of music and technology creates new sounds.
words.ex_cn: 音乐与技术的融合创造了新的声音。
words.en: The process or result of joining two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.tr: adj. 液压的；流体的；利用液体压力的；
words.ex: The hydraulic brake system stops the car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 液压制动系统能快速让汽车停下。
words.en: Hydraulic refers to the operation of machinery or systems by the movement and force of liquid, especially water or oil.

words.ex: The steam condenses into water when it touches the cold glass.
words.ex_cn: 当蒸汽接触到冷的玻璃时，会凝结成水。
words.en: If you condense something, especially a piece of writing or a speech, you make it shorter, usually by including only the most important parts.

words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.tr:
adj. 可变的；易变的；
n. 变量；
words.ex: The weather is variable in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气是多变的。
words.en: A variable is something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation.

words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.tr:
n. 代表；典型事物；
adj. 典型的；有代表性的；代议制的；
words.ex: He is the representative of our class.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们班的代表。
words.en: A representative is a person who has been chosen to act or make decisions on behalf of another person or a group of people.

words.tr: v. 结晶；定形；（使）具体化；变明确
words.ex: The idea began to crystallize after many talks.
words.ex_cn: 经过多次讨论，这个想法开始明朗起来。
words.en: To crystallize means to cause something to form into crystals or to become clear and definite in form.

words.ex: She wore a gorgeous dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件华丽的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: If you say that something is gorgeous, you mean that it gives you a lot of pleasure or is very attractive.

words.ex: The angle of the roof helps rain run off.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的角度有助于雨水流下。
words.en: An angle is the space between two lines or surfaces that meet, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The government imposed a new tax on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 政府对糖征收了一项新税。
words.en: To impose means to officially force a rule, tax, punishment, etc. to be obeyed or received.

words.ex: He apologizes for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而道歉。
words.en: To express regret for something that one has done wrong.

words.ex: My colleague helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
words.en: A colleague is someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

words.tr:
v. 抽水；打气；
n. 泵；抽水机；打气机；
words.ex: He pumps water from the well every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上从井里抽水。
words.en: A pump is a device that moves fluids (liquids or gases), or sometimes slurries, by mechanical action. Pumps can be classified into three major groups according to the method they use to move the fluid: direct lift, displacement, and gravity pumps.

words.tr:
v. 豁免；
adj. 被免除的；
words.ex: The school exempted him from the test.
words.ex_cn: 学校免除了他的考试。
words.en: If someone or something is exempt from a particular rule, duty, or obligation, they do not have to follow it or do it.

words.ex: The marine birds fly over the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这些海鸟在海面上飞翔。
words.en: Marine is used to describe things relating to the sea or to the ships and boats which sail on it.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片钉在板上。
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.ex: He is still immature and often cries when upset.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然不成熟，生气时经常哭。
words.en: If you describe someone as immature, you are criticizing them because they do not behave in a sensible or responsible way, or because they have not developed emotionally or mentally to the level that is normal for their age.

words.tr: n. 入学介绍；岗前训练；方向；取向；
words.ex: The school held an orientation for new students on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 学校在周一为新生举行了入学介绍。
words.en: The act of orienting or the state of being oriented; the determination of the relative position of something or someone (especially oneself).

words.tr: adj. 攻击性的；有进取心的；侵略性的；
words.ex: The dog showed aggressive behavior toward strangers.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗对陌生人表现出攻击性行为。
words.en: An aggressive person or animal has a quality of anger and determination that makes them ready to attack others.

words.ex: The child clings to his mother's leg.
words.ex_cn: 孩子紧贴着妈妈的腿。
words.en: If you cling to someone or something, you hold onto them tightly.

words.ex: The factory's output increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月的产量增加了。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.ex: The hostile neighbor shouted at us every morning.
words.ex_cn: 那个敌意的邻居每天早上都对我们大喊大叫。
words.en: If you are hostile to another person or an idea, you disagree with them or disapprove of them, often showing this in your behavior.

words.ex: He resolved the problem with a simple plan.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个简单的计划解决了问题。
words.en: If you resolve to do something, you make a firm decision to do it.

words.ex: They laid new tile in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他们在厨房铺了新的瓷砖。
words.en: A tile is a flat piece of baked clay, carpet, cork, or other material, used especially for covering roofs and floors.

words.tr: n. 保证；事业； v. 承担；从事；“undertake”的现在分词；
words.ex: He gave an undertaking to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他保证按时完成项目。
words.en: An undertaking is a task or project, especially one that is important or difficult.

words.ex: The radio transmits music to listeners.
words.ex_cn: 收音机将音乐传递给听众。
words.en: To send or pass something from one person, place, or thing to another.

words.ex: The sloth moves very slowly in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 树懒在树上移动得非常慢。
words.en: Sloth is a disinclination to work or exert oneself; laziness, or a slow-moving tropical American mammal that lives in trees.

words.tr: adj. 流行的；受欢迎的；大众的；
words.ex: This song is popular among teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在青少年中很流行。
words.en: liked, admired, or enjoyed by many people or by a particular person or group

words.ex: The furry cat curled up on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 那只毛茸茸的猫蜷缩在沙发上。
words.en: Covered with or resembling fur.

words.ex: He showed restraint when he stayed calm during the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持冷静，表现出了克制。
words.en: Restraint is a measure or condition that keeps someone or something under control or within limits.

words.ex: The star's luminosity is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这颗恒星的光度很高。
words.en: Luminosity is the intrinsic brightness of a celestial object, or the total amount of energy emitted by a star, galaxy, or other astronomical object per unit time.

words.tr: adj. 最外面的；（离中心）最远的
words.ex: The outermost layer of the onion is brown.
words.ex_cn: 洋葱最外层是棕色的。
words.en: situated at the farthest possible point from the center

words.ex: He has a slight cold.
words.ex_cn: 他有点轻微的感冒。
words.en: A slight change, difference, or action is not very great or important.

words.ex: She spread butter on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上抹了黄油。
words.en: Butter is a pale yellow edible fatty substance made by churning cream and used as a spread or in cooking.

words.ex: The plant shows vegetative growth in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物在春天表现出植物生长。
