words.en: Relating to vegetation or plant life; also used to describe a state of minimal consciousness in a person who is severely brain-damaged.

words.ex: The doctor tested his plasma for antibodies.
words.ex_cn: 医生检测了他的血浆中的抗体。
words.en: Plasma is the clear, straw-colored liquid portion of blood that remains after red blood cells, white blood cells, platelets and other cellular components are removed. It is the single largest component of human blood, comprising about 55 percent, and contains water, salts, enzymes, antibodies and other proteins.

words.tr:
n. 群；蜂群
v. 云集；充满
words.ex: Bees swarm around the flower.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂围绕着花朵成群飞舞。
words.en: A swarm is a large group of insects, especially bees, moving together. As a verb, it means to move in or form a swarm.

words.ex: The child learns locomotion by crawling.
words.ex_cn: 孩子通过爬行学习移动。
words.en: The ability to move from place to place.

words.ex: He showed the utmost care when handling the fragile glass.
words.ex_cn: 他在处理易碎的玻璃时表现出了最大的小心。
words.en: The greatest or highest degree of something.

words.ex: He kept his dignity even when he was poor.
words.ex_cn: 即使他很穷，他依然保持尊严。
words.en: Dignity is the quality of being worthy of honor or respect.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 未充分发展的；初步的；基本的；
words.ex: His knowledge of math is rudimentary.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学的了解是初步的。
words.en: Rudimentary means relating to the basic or simplest aspects of a subject, or being in the earliest stages of development.

words.ex: The trees bud in spring.
words.ex_cn: 树木在春天发芽。
words.en: A bud is a small pointed lump that appears on a tree or plant and develops into a leaf or flower.

words.ex: The remainder of the cake was given to the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的剩余部分给了邻居。
words.en: The remainder is what is left over after other parts have been taken away or used.

words.ex: Children depend on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you say that one thing depends on another, you mean that the first thing will be affected or determined by the second.

words.tr:
v. 睡眠
n. 睡眠（常复数）
words.ex: The baby fell into a deep slumber after feeding.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝喂完奶后进入了深深的睡眠。
words.en: Slumber is a state of sleep, especially one that is peaceful and restful.

words.tr:
v. 补充；与…相辅相成；
n. 补足物；补语；余角；
words.ex: The red scarf complements her blue coat.
words.ex_cn: 这条红围巾补充了她的蓝外套。
words.en: To complement something means to make it complete or perfect by adding something to it.

words.ex: He strives to finish his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力完成作业。
words.en: If you strive to do something or strive for something, you make a great effort to do it or get it.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.ex: He eats spaghetti for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃意大利面。
words.en: Spaghetti is a type of pasta that is long, thin, and solid, originally from Italy.

words.tr: n. 强烈的抗议（或反对）
words.ex: There was an outcry when the school closed the library.
words.ex_cn: 当学校关闭图书馆时，引起了强烈的抗议。
words.en: An outcry is a reaction of strong disapproval and anger shown by the public or by a group of people, often in the form of protests or complaints.

words.ex: He retains his old photos in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧照片保存在一个盒子里。
words.en: If you retain something, you keep it or continue to have it.

words.ex: The ball keeps moving because of inertia.
words.ex_cn: 球因为惯性继续移动。
words.en: Inertia is the tendency of a physical object to continue moving in a straight line at a constant speed, or to stay at rest, unless it is acted upon by a force.

words.ex: Heat will liquefy the ice.
words.ex_cn: 加热会使冰融化。
words.en: To make or become liquid.

words.ex: He ate grilled shrimp for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了烤虾。
words.en: A shrimp is a small shellfish with a long tail and many legs, which can be eaten as food.

words.tr:
n. 社论；
adj. 编辑的；
words.ex: The newspaper published an editorial about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 报纸发表了一篇关于气候变化的社论。
words.en: An editorial is an article in a newspaper which gives the opinion of the editor or publisher on a topic or item of news.

words.ex: He tries to assimilate new words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力吸收新单词。
words.en: To assimilate means to take in and understand fully ideas, information, or culture, or to make something become part of a group or system.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.ex: He grows soybean in his field.
words.ex_cn: 他在田里种植大豆。
words.en: A soybean is a type of legume native to East Asia, widely grown for its edible bean which has numerous uses.

words.tr:
adj. 恼怒的；气恼的
v. 使恼怒；使气恼；“annoy”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He is annoyed by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他被吵闹的声音惹恼了。
words.en: If you are annoyed, you are fairly angry about something.

words.ex: He waved a red banner in the parade.
words.ex_cn: 他在游行中挥舞着一面红旗子。
words.en: A banner is a long strip of cloth with a message or design on it, used especially for advertising or as a symbol of a particular group or cause.

words.tr:
n. 因素；要素；倍数；
v. 把…因素包括进去；
words.ex: Weather is a factor in the game's outcome.
words.ex_cn: 天气是比赛结果的一个因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.

words.ex: The spy tried to infiltrate the enemy base.
words.ex_cn: 间谍试图渗透敌方基地。
words.en: To enter or gain access to (an organization, place, etc.) surreptitiously and gradually, especially in order to acquire secret information.

words.tr:
v. 过滤；滤去；渗入
n. 过滤；滤去
words.ex: The soil is leached of nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 土壤中的养分被过滤掉了。
words.en: To leach means to remove or be removed from a substance by a percolating liquid, especially to remove soluble constituents from soil, ash, or similar material by the action of percolating water.

words.ex: The team gained momentum after scoring the first goal.
words.ex_cn: 球队在进第一个球后获得了势头。
words.en: Momentum is the ability of something to keep increasing, developing, or being more successful.

words.tr: adj. 有气味的；有臭气的
words.ex: The trash is odorous after being left in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾在阳光下放久了会有气味。
words.en: Having a distinctive smell, especially an unpleasant one.

words.tr: v. 滤；渗透；用渗滤壶煮咖啡
words.ex: Water percolates through the soil.
words.ex_cn: 水透过土壤渗出。
words.en: If a liquid percolates, it moves slowly through a substance that has very small holes in it.

words.ex: The jet flies at supersonic speed.
words.ex_cn: 这架喷气式飞机以超音速飞行。
words.en: relating to speeds that are faster than the speed of sound

words.ex: The thermal blanket keeps you warm.
words.ex_cn: 这个保暖毯让你暖和。
words.en: relating to heat or temperature

words.ex: The coefficient of x is 5 in this equation.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方程中，x 的系数是 5。
words.en: A coefficient is a number that measures a particular characteristic of a substance or a system under specified conditions.

words.tr:
adj. 差别的；有区别的
n. 差别；差额；差价
words.ex: There is a differential cost between the two brands.
words.ex_cn: 这两个品牌之间有不同的价格。
words.en: A differential is a difference between things, especially between things that should be the same. In mathematics, a differential is an infinitesimal change in a variable.

words.ex: The sun vaporizes water from the lake.
words.ex_cn: 太阳把湖里的水蒸发了。
words.en: To convert or be converted into vapor.

words.ex: The bee does a waggle to show where the flowers are.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂通过摇摆来指示花朵的位置。
words.en: To move or cause to move with short quick movements from side to side or up and down.

words.ex: The approximation of pi is 3.14.
words.ex_cn: π的近似值是3.14。
words.en: An approximation is a fact, object, or description which is similar to something else, but which is not exactly the same.

words.ex: The line bisects the angle into two equal parts.
words.ex_cn: 这条线将角平分为两个相等的部分。
words.en: To divide something into two equal parts.

words.tr: adj. 可计算的；可推断出的
words.ex: The risk is calculable and manageable.
words.ex_cn: 这种风险是可以计算和管理的。
words.en: If something is calculable, it can be calculated or estimated.

words.ex: He drew an ellipse on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个椭圆。
words.en: An ellipse is a regular oval shape, traced by a point moving in a plane so that the sum of its distances from two other points (the foci) is constant.

words.tr: n. 被除数；股份红利；股息
words.ex: In 12 ÷ 3 = 4, the dividend is 12.
words.en: A dividend is a sum of money paid regularly (typically annually) by a company to its shareholders out of its profits (or reserves).

words.ex: The company used a new formula to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用了一个新方案来解决问题。
words.en: A formula is a plan or method that is used to achieve a particular goal, especially in science or mathematics.

words.tr:
n. 侵蚀；风化
v. 使受风吹雨打；风干；经受住；“weather”的现在分词
words.ex: The rocks are weathering slowly in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 岩石在阳光下缓慢风化。
words.en: The process of wearing away or changing the appearance or texture of something by long exposure to the atmosphere.

words.tr:
v. （使）失去光泽；使晦暗；玷污
n. 晦暗；污渍
words.ex: The silver spoon will tarnish if not cleaned.
words.ex_cn: 如果银勺不清洗，就会变暗。
words.en: If you say that something tarnishes someone's reputation or image, you mean that it causes people to have a worse opinion of them than they would otherwise have had.

words.ex: He wants to inquire about the bus schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他想询问公交车的时刻表。
words.en: If you inquire about something, you ask for information about it.

words.ex: He extrapolates the trend from last year's data.
words.ex_cn: 他从去年的数据中推断出趋势。
words.en: To extrapolate is to estimate or conclude something by extending or projecting known information.

words.tr:
v. 剩下；留下；依然不变；
n. 遗迹；残余；遗体；
words.ex: Only two cookies remains on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌上只剩下两块饼干了。
words.en: The parts left over after other parts have been removed, used, or destroyed.

words.ex: The company values flexibility in work hours.
words.ex_cn: 公司重视工作时间的灵活性。
words.en: Flexibility refers to the quality of bending easily without breaking, or the ability to be easily modified to respond to altered circumstances or conditions.

words.ex: The artist painted a colorful mural on the school wall.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家在学校墙上画了一幅色彩斑斓的壁画。
words.en: A mural is a large painting, typically executed directly on a wall.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；天平；秤；
v. （使）相抵；（使）平衡；
words.ex: She maintains a good balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休息之间保持良好的平衡。
words.en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up. Also, it refers to the state of having your weight spread equally so that you do not fall. In finance, it refers to the amount of money you have in a bank account.

words.ex: He sent a telegraph to his family.
words.ex_cn: 他给家人发了一封电报。
words.en: A system for transmitting messages from a distance along a wire, especially one creating signals by making and breaking an electrical connection.

words.ex: Going first is a privilege, not a right.
words.ex_cn: 优先权是一种特权，而不是权利。
words.en: A privilege is a special right or advantage that only one person or group has.

words.ex: The teacher showed a chart of temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一张温度图表。
words.en: A chart is a graphical representation of data, in which the data is represented by symbols, such as bars in a bar chart, lines in a line chart, or slices in a pie chart.

words.ex: He scan the QR code with his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机扫描了二维码。
words.en: To look at something carefully or quickly in order to find out specific information or to examine something thoroughly.

words.tr: n. 代表大会；议会；国会；
words.ex: The congress met to discuss new laws.
words.ex_cn: 代表大会召开以讨论新法律。
words.en: A congress is a formal meeting of representatives, as of various nations, to discuss problems or to make decisions.

words.tr: n. 便利设施；舒适条件；公共设施；
words.ex: The apartment has good amenities like a gym and a swimming pool.
words.ex_cn: 这套公寓有健身房和游泳池等便利设施。
words.en: An amenity is something that makes a place more pleasant or comfortable to live in.

words.tr: n. 自命不凡；自称；标榜；虚荣
words.ex: His pretension made others think he was better than them.
words.ex_cn: 他的自命不凡让别人觉得他比他们强。
words.en: If you say that someone has pretensions, you mean that they claim or pretend that they are more important, intelligent, or skilled than they really are.

words.tr: adj. 感官的；肉欲的；愉悦感官的；耽于肉欲的
words.ex: The sensual smell of fresh bread made her hungry.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的感官香味让她感到饥饿。
words.en: Relating to or involving gratification of the senses and physical, especially sexual, pleasure.

words.tr: adv. 可怕地；严肃地；坚强地；冷酷地
words.ex: He looked grimly at the broken window.
words.ex_cn: 他严峻地看着那扇破碎的窗户。
words.en: In a very serious or stern manner, often because of something unpleasant or worrying.

words.tr: n. 运作方式；力学；“mechanic”的复数；
words.ex: The mechanics of this machine are simple to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的运作方式很简单易懂。
words.en: Mechanics is the branch of physics that deals with the action of forces on bodies and with motion, comprised of kinetics, statics, and kinematics.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.tr: v. 重新刷新；翻新；整修
words.ex: They will refurbish the old house next month.
words.ex_cn: 他们下个月将翻新这栋老房子。
words.en: To refurbish something means to clean it, decorate it, and provide it with new equipment or facilities, especially so that it is more attractive or more useful.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built the pyramids.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人建造了金字塔。
words.en: Belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence.

words.ex: This portable charger works well on trips.
words.ex_cn: 这个便携式充电器在旅行时很好用。
words.en: Capable of being carried or moved about with ease.

words.ex: He was a faithful disciple of the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是老师的一名忠实弟子。
words.en: A disciple is a follower or student of a teacher, leader, or philosopher.

words.ex: The museum will exhibit ancient coins next month.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆下个月将展览古钱币。
words.en: To exhibit something means to show it in a public place so that people can go to see it. It can also mean to show a particular quality, ability, or type of behavior.

words.ex: He wrote her a letter to rekindle their friendship.
words.ex_cn: 他给她写了一封信，想重新激起他们的友谊。
words.en: To rekindle something means to make it start again or become active again after it has stopped or become less active.

words.ex: A bright meteor flashed across the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 一颗明亮的流星划过夜空。
words.en: A meteor is a piece of rock or metal that burns very brightly when it enters the earth's atmosphere from space.

words.ex: He fastened the strap around his wrist.
words.ex_cn: 他把带子系在手腕上。
words.en: A strap is a narrow piece of leather, cloth, or other material that is used to fasten, secure, or carry something, or to hold onto something.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.ex: The weather will deteriorate tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天天气会恶化。
words.en: If something deteriorates, it becomes worse in some way.

words.ex: The salamander crawled under a wet leaf.
words.ex_cn: 蝾螈爬到了一片湿叶子下面。
words.en: A salamander is a small animal that looks like a lizard and lives both on land and in water. Salamanders are amphibians, which means they can live both in water and on land.

words.tr:
n. 纽带；联系；债券；保释金；协定
v. （使）黏合；相互联结
words.ex: Family is the bond that keeps us together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭是我们团结的纽带。
words.en: A bond between people is a strong feeling of friendship, love, or shared beliefs and experiences that unites them.

words.ex: A pocket calculator is handy for math problems.
words.ex_cn: 便携式计算器对于数学问题很方便。
words.en: If something is handy, it is useful and easy to use or to reach.

words.tr: n. 测量仪器；规格；评估；
words.ex: The mechanic used a gauge to check the tire pressure.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用一个测量仪器来检查轮胎气压。
words.en: A gauge is a device that measures the amount or quantity of something and shows the measurement in a form that is easy to read, such as a dial or a digital display.

words.ex: The embryo grows inside the mother's womb.
words.ex_cn: 胚胎在母亲的子宫内生长。
words.en: An embryo is an unborn animal or human being in the very early stages of development.

words.ex: The company's profits quadrupled last year.
words.ex_cn: 公司去年的利润增长了四倍。
words.en: To quadruple something means to make it four times as great in size, amount, or number.

words.ex: Honesty is an integral part of a good relationship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是良好关系中不可或缺的一部分。
words.en: Something that is integral is very important or necessary. If something is an integral part of a whole, it is an essential part of that whole.

words.ex: The doctor said the patient needs urgent care.
words.ex_cn: 医生说病人需要紧急治疗。
words.en: If something is urgent, it needs to be dealt with as soon as possible.

words.ex: The quotient of 10 divided by 2 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 10除以2的商是5。
words.en: A quotient is the result you get by dividing one number by another.

words.tr: adj. 一年一次的；每年的；
words.ex: The school holds an annual sports day.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年举行一次运动会。
words.en: An annual event happens once every year.

words.tr: adj. [数] 乘法的；增加的; n. 乘法；倍数词
words.ex: The multiplicative inverse of 2 is 0.5.
words.ex_cn: 2的乘法逆元是0.5。
words.en: Relating to or involving multiplication; tending to multiply or capable of multiplying.

words.ex: He works in a small studio near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一个小工作室工作。
words.en: A studio is a room where an artist, photographer, or designer works, or a place where movies or television programs are made.

words.ex: He drew a geometric shape on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个几何图形。
words.en: Relating to geometry, or according to its methods and principles.

words.tr:
adj. 零下的；负的；
n. 缺点；
prep. 减去；
words.ex: The temperature is minus ten degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 气温是零下十摄氏度。
words.en: A minus is a mathematical symbol that represents subtraction or a negative quantity.

words.ex: The point has an ordinate of 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个点的纵坐标是5。
words.en: In mathematics, an ordinate is the y-coordinate of a point in a two-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system.

words.tr: adj. 数值的；数字的（等于 numerical）; n. 数；数字
words.ex: The code uses numeric values to calculate the result.
words.ex_cn: 这个代码使用数值来计算结果。
words.en: Numeric means relating to numbers or consisting of numbers.

words.tr:
adj. 矩形的；长方形的；椭圆形的；椭圆体的
n. 矩形或椭圆形（的物体）
words.ex: The table is oblong in shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是长方形的。
words.en: An oblong shape is a shape that is longer than it is wide, with straight sides and right angles.

words.ex: The study uses quantitative data to measure results.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究使用定量数据来测量结果。
words.en: Relating to, measuring, or measured by the quantity of something rather than its quality.

words.ex: They have a reciprocal agreement to help each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们有一个互相帮助的互惠协议。
words.en: A reciprocal action or agreement involves two people or groups who do the same thing to each other or agree to help each other in a similar way.

words.ex: The line touches the circle at one point and is a tangent.
words.ex_cn: 这条线与圆在一个点相切，是一条切线。
words.en: A tangent is a straight line or plane that touches a curve or curved surface at a point, but if extended does not cross it at that point. In a more general sense, it can also refer to a sudden digression or change of course.

words.ex: The teacher will allot five minutes for questions.
words.ex_cn: 老师会分配五分钟提问。
words.en: If something is allotted to someone, it is given to them as their share.

words.tr:
n. 抵制；拒绝参加；
v. 抵制；拒绝参加；
words.ex: The students organized a boycott of the unfair school rule.
words.ex_cn: 学生们组织了对这项不公平校规的抵制。
words.en: If a country, group, or person boycotts a country, organization, or activity, they refuse to be involved with it in any way because they disapprove of it.

words.ex: He received compensation for his injured leg.
words.ex_cn: 他因腿部受伤获得了赔偿。
words.en: Compensation is something, typically money, awarded to someone in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury.

words.tr:
adj. 序数的；顺序的
n. 序数
words.ex: The ordinal number is third.
words.ex_cn: 序数是第三。
words.en: An ordinal number is a number such as first, second, third, etc., that shows the position of something in a list.

words.ex: The fence marks the perimeter of the garden.
words.ex_cn: 围栏标出了花园的边界。
words.en: The perimeter of an area or object is the total length of its sides or outer boundary.

words.tr:
v. 成为三倍；使增至三倍；
n. 三倍的数；三个一组；
adj. 三部分的；
words.ex: The company's profits tripled last year.
words.ex_cn: 该公司去年的利润增长了三倍。
words.en: To triple something means to make it three times as much in size or number.

words.ex: The school will curtail recess time during exams.
words.ex_cn: 学校在考试期间将缩短课间休息时间。
words.en: If you curtail something, you reduce or limit it.

words.ex: The country has a budget deficit this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年这个国家的预算不足额。
words.en: A deficit is the amount by which something, especially a sum of money, is too small.

words.ex: Her motto is 'Never give up.'
words.ex_cn: 她的座右铭是‘永不放弃’。
words.en: A motto is a short sentence or phrase that expresses a rule for sensible behavior, especially a way of behaving in a particular situation.

words.ex: He reject the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了这份工作邀请。
words.en: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

words.tr: n. 紧张；紧张局势；紧张关系；
words.ex: There was tension between the two friends after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 两人争吵后，彼此之间出现了紧张。
words.en: Tension is a feeling of worry and anxiety which makes it difficult for you to relax. It can also refer to the state of being stretched tight or the degree of tightness of a stretched string, wire, etc.

words.tr:
n. 火焰
v. 燃烧；爆发；面红
words.ex: The candle flame flickered in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的火焰在风中摇曳。
words.en: A flame is a hot bright stream of burning gas that comes from something that is burning.

words.ex: The smoke came out of the vent.
words.ex_cn: 烟从排气口飘了出来。
words.en: A vent is a hole or opening that allows air, gas, or liquid to pass out of or into a confined space.

words.ex: He jogs every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上慢跑以保持健康。
words.en: To run at a slow, steady pace, especially as a form of exercise.

words.ex: The child mimics her mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿她妈妈的声音。
words.en: If someone or something mimics another person or thing, they try to be like them or copy their behavior or characteristics.

words.ex: He works in a laboratory on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 他在星期五去实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific research, experiments, or teaching.

words.tr:
adj. 十字形的；交叉的
adv. 十字形地；交叉着
v. 划十字；纵横交错
words.ex: The criss-cross lines on the paper made a net.
words.ex_cn: 纸上的十字形线条形成了一个网。
words.en: To move back and forth over something, or to mark something with lines that cross each other.

words.ex: The lemon tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 这个柠檬尝起来是酸的。
words.en: Having a sharp, acidic taste; not sweet.

words.ex: The teacher will critique the student's essay tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会对学生的作文发表评论。
words.en: A critique is a detailed analysis and assessment of something, especially a literary, philosophical, or political theory.

words.ex: The viral infection made him feverish for three days.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒引起的感染让他发烧了三天。
words.en: Relating to or caused by a virus; becoming very popular by circulating quickly from person to person, especially on the internet.

words.tr: n. 过错；故障；缺陷；断层；
words.ex: It was his fault that the car crashed.
words.ex_cn: 汽车撞车是他的过错。
words.en: A fault is a mistake or a weakness in something or someone.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.tr:
n. 后者（the ~）；
adj. 后期的；后面的；
words.ex: I like tea and coffee; I prefer the latter.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢茶和咖啡；我更喜欢后者。
words.en: The latter is used to refer to the second of two things or people mentioned.

words.tr: adj. 最低限度的；极少的；最小的；
words.ex: He made minimal changes to the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他对计划做了最低限度的修改。
words.en: Something that is minimal is very small in quantity, value, or degree.

words.ex: Please refrigerate the milk after opening.
words.ex_cn: 打开牛奶后请冷藏。
words.en: To refrigerate something means to make it cold, usually in a refrigerator, in order to preserve it.

words.ex: The children play near the fountain in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园的喷泉附近玩耍。
words.en: A fountain is a structure that squirts water into the air to create a visual or auditory effect, or a natural source of water.

words.ex: The line is horizontal on the graph.
words.ex_cn: 这条线在图上是水平的。
words.en: Parallel to the plane of the horizon; at right angles to the vertical.

words.ex: He has an appetite for spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢辛辣食物。
words.en: A desire or liking for something, especially food.

words.tr:
adj. 垂直的；笔直的
n. 垂直线
words.ex: The lines are perpendicular to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这些线互相垂直。
words.en: At right angles to the plane of the horizon or a base line; vertical.

words.ex: His speech was very impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲非常令人印象深刻。
words.en: Something that is impressive makes you admire it because it is very good, large, important, etc.

words.ex: He gave a generous donation to the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他慷慨地捐钱给穷人。
words.en: A generous person gives more of something, especially money, than is usual or expected.

words.ex: They will liberate the prisoners tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天会释放这些囚犯。
words.en: To liberate a place or the people in it means to free them from the political or military control of another country, area, or group of people.

words.ex: The completion of the project took three months.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的完成花了三个月。
words.en: The act of finishing or making something whole or perfect.

words.ex: He tries to synthesize ideas from different books.
words.ex_cn: 他试图综合来自不同书籍的想法。
words.en: To synthesize means to combine different ideas, influences, or objects into a new whole, or to produce a substance by a chemical reaction in plants or animals.

words.ex: Honesty is an inherent quality of a good leader.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是好领导固有的品质。
words.en: Existing in something as a permanent, essential, or characteristic attribute.

words.ex: The judge was disinterested in the case.
words.ex_cn: 法官对这个案件持客观态度。
words.en: If someone is disinterested in something, they have no personal involvement or investment in it and are therefore able to judge it fairly.

words.ex: He has asthma and cannot run fast.
words.ex_cn: 他有哮喘，不能跑快。
words.en: A respiratory condition marked by spasms in the bronchi of the lungs, causing difficulty in breathing. It usually results from an allergic reaction or other forms of hypersensitivity.

words.tr: n. 狂热； 癖好；躁狂症
words.ex: He has a mania for collecting stamps.
words.ex_cn: 他痴迷于收集邮票。
words.en: An extreme enthusiasm or desire for something, often to the point of obsession.

words.ex: The teacher will inspect our homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会检查我们的作业。
words.en: If you inspect something, you look at it very carefully, usually in order to find out something about it.

words.ex: The sun scorch the ground in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天阳光灼烧地面。
words.en: To burn the surface of something so as to discolour or damage it.

words.tr:
n. 总计；集合体
adj. 合计的；总的
v. （使）聚集；聚合；总计为
words.ex: The aggregate of all sales this month is $50,000.
words.ex_cn: 本月所有销售额的总计是5万美元。
words.en: An aggregate is a number of things or people that are considered as a group or a whole.

words.ex: The engine has four cylinders.
words.ex_cn: 发动机有四个气缸。
words.en: A cylinder is a geometric figure with straight parallel sides and a circular or oval cross section.

words.ex: The injury impaired his ability to walk.
words.ex_cn: 这次受伤损害了他走路的能力。
words.en: If something impairs something such as an ability or the way something works, it damages it or makes it worse.

words.ex: The quality of this phone is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的质量很高。
words.en: The standard of something as measured against other things of a similar kind; the degree of excellence of something.

words.ex: The weather bureau issued a storm warning.
words.ex_cn: 气象局发布了风暴预警。
words.en: A bureau is an office, organization, or government department that collects and distributes information.

words.ex: The excavation revealed ancient pottery.
words.ex_cn: 挖掘发现了古代陶器。
words.en: The process of digging up and removing earth, especially at an archaeological site.

words.tr:
n. 旋转；
v. 旋转；
words.ex: The spin of the top made it stay upright.
words.ex_cn: 陀螺的旋转让它保持直立。
words.en: If something spins or if you spin it, it turns quickly around a central point.

words.tr: v. 侵蚀；腐蚀；逐渐丧失；削弱
words.ex: The wind erodes the sand slowly.
words.ex_cn: 风慢慢侵蚀着沙子。
words.en: If rock or soil erodes or is eroded by the weather, sea, or wind, it cracks and breaks so that it is gradually destroyed.

words.ex: They settled in a small village after retirement.
words.ex_cn: 他们退休后在一个小村庄安顿下来。
words.en: To settle means to resolve or come to an agreement about a dispute, to establish a permanent home in a particular place, or to come to rest in a particular position.

words.ex: The virus made many people sick.
words.ex_cn: 这个病毒让很多人病了。
words.en: A virus is a very small organism that causes infectious diseases in people, animals, and plants.

words.tr:
n. 状态；州；国家；
v. 陈述；说明；
adj. 国事礼仪（或规格）的；州的；
words.ex: The state of the car is very poor.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的状态非常差。
words.en: A state is a condition or way of being that something or someone is in. It can also refer to a nation or territory considered as an organized political community under one government.

words.ex: The weather report said it's 90 degrees Fahrenheit today.
words.ex_cn: 天气预报说今天是90华氏度。
words.en: Of or relating to a temperature scale that registers the freezing point of water as 32° and the boiling point as 212° at one atmosphere of pressure.

words.ex: The cat creeps slowly toward the bird.
words.ex_cn: 猫蹑手蹑脚地向鸟靠近。
words.en: To move slowly and quietly, especially in a way that does not attract attention.

words.tr: adj. 彻底的；完全的；详尽的；
words.ex: He did a thorough cleaning of the house.
words.ex_cn: 他对房子进行了彻底的清洁。
words.en: A thorough action or activity is one that is done very carefully and in a detailed way so that nothing is forgotten.

words.ex: The colors in the rainbow cover a wide spectrum.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹中的颜色覆盖了广泛的范围。
words.en: A spectrum is a range of a particular type of thing, often a range of colors, ideas, or opinions.

words.tr:
n. 彻底检修；大修；彻底革新；全面修订
v. 彻底检修；超过（赛跑对手）
words.ex: The plane needs an overhaul before the next flight.
words.ex_cn: 这架飞机在下次飞行前需要彻底检修。
words.en: If you overhaul a system or method, you examine it carefully and make many changes in it in order to improve it.

words.ex: Babies have an innate ability to cry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿生来就有哭泣的能力。
words.en: An innate quality or ability is one that you were born with, not one you have learned.

words.ex: The village by the lake is picturesque.
words.ex_cn: 湖边的村庄如画般美丽。
words.en: A picturesque place is attractive and interesting, especially in a way that is old-fashioned or unusual.

words.ex: He uses graphite to draw pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他用石墨画画。
words.en: Graphite is a soft, black form of carbon that is used in pencils and as a lubricant.

words.ex: My teacher encourages me to speak English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师鼓励我每天说英语。
words.en: If you encourage someone, you give them confidence, for example by letting them know that what they are doing is good and telling them that they should continue to do it.

words.tr:
v. 拖曳；搅乱；洗牌；移来移去
n. 拖着脚走；洗牌；混在一起
words.ex: He shuffle his feet across the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他拖着脚在地板上走。
words.en: To shuffle is to walk by dragging one's feet along or without lifting them fully from the ground. It also means to mix up the order of things, especially cards in a deck.

words.ex: He modulates his voice to sound calm.
words.ex_cn: 他调节自己的声音以显得平静。
words.en: To modulate means to change or adjust something, such as your voice or a piece of equipment, to achieve a desired effect or to make it suitable for a particular situation.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；退款
v. 减少
words.ex: He got a rebate on his new TV.
words.ex_cn: 他买新电视时得到了一笔回扣。
words.en: A rebate is a partial refund to someone who has paid too much for tax, rent, or a utility.

words.ex: A finch sings loudly in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 一只金丝雀在树上大声歌唱。
words.en: A finch is a small bird with a short, stout bill used for cracking seeds.

words.ex: He felt nostalgia when he saw his old toy.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到自己的旧玩具时，感到怀旧。
words.en: A sentimental longing or wistful affection for the past, typically for a period or place with happy personal associations.

words.tr:
n. 长裤子；短内裤； “pant”的复数
v. 喘气；喘息；“pant”的第三人称单数
words.ex: He is wearing blue pants.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着蓝色的裤子。
words.en: Pants are a piece of clothing that covers the body from the waist to the ankles and divides into two parts to cover each leg separately.

words.ex: The coach endorses the new player.
words.ex_cn: 教练支持这位新球员。
words.en: If you endorse someone or something, you say publicly that you support or approve of them.

words.ex: The stock market shows daily fluctuation.
words.ex_cn: 股票市场每天都有波动。
words.en: A fluctuation is a change in something, especially in a continuous process such as temperature, prices, or levels of activity.

words.ex: The big company owns a subsidiary that makes phones.
words.ex_cn: 这家大公司拥有一家生产手机的附属公司。
words.en: A subsidiary is a company which is part of a larger and more important company.

words.tr:
n. 进口；重要性；
v. 进口；
words.ex: The country increased its import of oil last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家增加了石油的进口。
words.en: To bring in (goods or services) from a foreign country for sale or use.

words.ex: You need basic math as a prerequisite for this course.
words.ex_cn: 你学习这门课程的前提是掌握基础数学。
words.en: A prerequisite is something that must exist or happen before something else can exist or happen.

words.ex: He took out a mortgage to buy his first house.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了一笔抵押贷款来购买他的第一套房子。
words.en: A mortgage is a loan of money which you get from a bank or building society in order to buy a house.

words.ex: Water is a basic necessity for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本必需品。
words.en: Something that is necessary or indispensable.

words.tr: n.  外在性；外形；外部事物；（经济学名词）外部效应
words.ex: The factory causes an externality by polluting the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过污染河流造成了外部性。
words.en: An externality is a consequence of an economic activity that is experienced by unrelated third parties. It can be either positive or negative.

words.tr: adj. 赚大钱的；获利多的；
words.ex: He took a lucrative job at a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他去了一家科技公司做一份赚大钱的工作。
words.en: A lucrative activity or job is one that you can earn a lot of money from.

words.ex: They will negotiate the price with the seller.
words.ex_cn: 他们会与卖家协商价格。
words.en: If people negotiate with each other or negotiate an agreement, they talk about a problem or a situation such as a business arrangement in order to solve the problem or complete the arrangement.

words.tr: v. 惠顾；资助；屈尊俯就
words.ex: He often patronizes the local bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他经常光顾这家本地面包店。
words.en: If someone patronizes you, they speak or behave towards you in a way which seems friendly, but which shows that they think they are superior to you in some way.

words.ex: He worked hard to recoup his losses.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以重获损失的资金。
words.en: To recoup means to regain something lost or to compensate for something, especially money or losses.

words.ex: The monetary policy affects prices.
words.ex_cn: 货币政策影响价格。
words.en: Monetary means relating to money, especially the total amount of money in a country.

words.tr: v. 弥补；兑换；付清；赎回；履行
words.ex: He worked hard to redeem his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作来弥补自己的错误。
words.en: To redeem something means to get it back by paying a sum of money or by doing something to compensate for a fault or mistake.

words.ex: The choir sings every Sunday in church.
words.ex_cn: 唱诗班每周日在教堂唱歌。
words.en: A choir is a group of people who sing together, especially in a church or school.

words.ex: The water in the pond was stagnant.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里的水不流动。
words.en: If something such as a business or economy is stagnant, there is little activity or change.

words.tr: n. 盆地；流域；水池；脸盆；
words.ex: The river flows into a large basin.
words.ex_cn: 河流流入一个巨大的盆地。
words.en: A basin is a large or small depression in the Earth's surface or a large container that holds water.

words.ex: The premise of his argument is that everyone is equal.
words.ex_cn: 他论点的前提是人人平等。
words.en: A premise is a statement or idea that forms the basis for a reasonable line of argument.

words.tr:
n. 额外费用；附加费
v. 额外索价；附加罚款
words.ex: He paid a surcharge for extra baggage.
words.ex_cn: 他为额外行李支付了附加费。
words.en: An additional charge or payment.

words.tr: v. 办理；交易；谈判；执行
words.ex: They transact business online every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天在线做生意。
words.en: If you transact business, you conduct business such as buying or selling goods or services.

words.ex: Drugs can alleviate pain.
words.ex_cn: 药物可以减轻疼痛。
words.en: To make something less severe or intense.

words.ex: The rodent ran quickly across the floor.
words.ex_cn: 这只啮齿动物迅速跑过地板。
words.en: A rodent is a small mammal which has sharp front teeth that it uses for gnawing. Rodents include rats, mice, and squirrels.

words.ex: He is always punctual for class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课总是准时。
words.en: If you are punctual, you do something or arrive somewhere at the right time and are not late.

words.tr: v. 缠住；“dog”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The reporter dogged the politician everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 记者紧紧跟随这位政治家到处。
words.en: If you describe someone's actions as dogged, you mean that they are determined to continue with something even if it becomes difficult or dangerous.

words.ex: He did a preliminary test before the main experiment.
words.ex_cn: 他在主要实验之前做了一个初步测试。
words.en: Preliminary means something that is done or happens before the main part or event, especially as an introduction or preparation.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.ex: She saw the aurora in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 她在夜空中看到了极光。
words.en: An aurora is a natural light display in the sky, predominantly seen in the high latitude (Arctic and Antarctic) regions, caused by the collision of solar wind and magnetospheric charged particles with the high altitude atmosphere.

words.ex: The spaceship travels through interstellar space.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙飞船在星际空间中航行。
words.en: Existing or occurring between stars.

words.ex: This book is about the realm of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于人工智能领域的。
words.en: A realm is a country ruled by a king or queen, or an area of activity, interest, or knowledge.

words.ex: He gave careful consideration to his decision.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的决定进行了仔细考虑。
words.en: Consideration is the process of giving careful thought to something before making a decision or taking action. It also refers to the quality of being thoughtful towards the needs and feelings of others.

words.tr: n. 航空；航空学；飞行（术）；
words.ex: He works in aviation as a pilot.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名飞行员从事航空工作。
words.en: Aviation is the operation and production of aircraft.

words.ex: He tried to manipulate the results to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他试图操纵结果来赢得比赛。
words.en: To manipulate something means to handle or control it skillfully, often in a way that is considered unfair or dishonest.

words.tr:
n. 锤子；
v. 锤打；
words.ex: He hit the nail with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子敲钉子。
words.en: A hammer is a tool that consists of a heavy piece of metal at the end of a handle, used for hitting things.

words.ex: The shirt is made of synthetic fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫是合成纤维制成的。
words.en: Synthetic products are made from chemicals or artificial substances rather than from natural ones.

words.ex: The government does a census every ten years.
words.ex_cn: 政府每十年进行一次人口普查。
words.en: A census is an official count or survey of a population, typically recording various details of individuals.

words.ex: The farmer works hard to sustain his crops.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民努力维持他的庄稼。
words.en: To sustain something means to continue it or maintain it for a period of time.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；攫住
n. 紧抓；离合器；一窝雏；一小群；紧要关头
words.ex: He clutched the rope tightly when he slipped.
words.ex_cn: 当他滑倒时，他紧紧抓住了绳子。
words.en: To clutch something means to hold it tightly, usually because you are afraid or anxious. In a vehicle, the clutch is a pedal that you press with your foot to change gears.

words.tr: adj. 明智的；有判断力的；恰当的；合理的；
words.ex: It is sensible to wear a coat in cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 在寒冷的天气里穿外套是明智的。
words.en: A sensible person is able to make good judgments and decisions based on reason rather than emotion.

words.tr:
n. 目标；对象；
v. 以…为目标；
words.ex: His target is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A target is something at which someone is aiming a weapon or other object.

words.tr: adj. 艳丽的；炫耀的；神气活现的
words.ex: He wears flamboyant clothes to stand out.
words.ex_cn: 他穿著華麗的衣服來引人注目。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is flamboyant, you mean that they are very noticeable, stylish, and exciting.

words.ex: The doctor checked the vein in his arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他手臂上的静脉。
words.en: A vein is a tube in your body that carries blood towards your heart. It can also refer to a thin layer of a mineral in rock, or a particular style or mood in writing or speech.

words.ex: She wore beautiful jewelry to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了漂亮的珠宝去参加派对。
words.en: Jewelry refers to decorative items worn for personal adornment, such as brooches, rings, necklaces, earrings, and bracelets. Jewelry may be attached to the body or the clothes, and the term is restricted to durable ornaments, excluding flowers for example.

words.tr:
v. 包装；收拾行李；
n. 包裹；小包；
words.ex: She packs the gift in colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩纸包装礼物。
words.en: A pack is a container of a particular kind, especially one made of strong paper or plastic and containing a number of the same items. As a verb, pack means to put something into a container, especially in a neat and efficient way.

words.ex: The satellite sends pictures from space.
words.ex_cn: 卫星从太空发送图片。
words.en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

words.ex: The correspondent reported the news from the city.
words.ex_cn: 记者从城市报道了新闻。
words.en: A correspondent is someone who reports news from a particular place or on a particular subject for a newspaper, magazine, or television or radio station.

words.ex: Her resilience helped her recover after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 她的复原力帮助她在事故后恢复。
words.en: The capacity to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness.

words.ex: I take a shower every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上都洗淋浴。
words.en: A shower is a device that sprays water over you so that you can wash yourself. It is also a short period of rain or snow.

words.ex: The long meeting was tedious.
words.ex_cn: 这场漫长的会议很沉闷。
words.en: If you describe something such as a job, task, or situation as tedious, you mean it is boring and rather frustrating.

words.ex: The Magna Carta is an old charter of rights.
words.ex_cn: 《大宪章》是一份古老的权力宪章。
words.en: A charter is a formal document describing the rights, aims, or principles of an organization or group of people.

words.ex: He is at the forefront of new technology.
words.ex_cn: 他处于新技术的前沿。
words.en: The forefront is the most forward part of something, especially in a literal or metaphorical sense, indicating the leading position in a particular field or activity.

words.tr: v. 旋转；“spin”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The child spun the top quickly.
words.ex_cn: 孩子快速地旋转了陀螺。
words.en: Spin is the past tense and past participle of spin, which means to turn or cause to turn or whirl around quickly.

words.tr: adj. 易接近的；可使用的；简单易懂的；可进入的；
words.ex: The park is accessible by bus.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园乘公交车可达。
words.en: If a place or building is accessible to people, it is easy for them to reach it or get into it. If an object is accessible, it is easy to reach.

words.ex: He will undertake a new project next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将从事一个新项目。
words.en: To undertake a task or job means to start doing it and accept responsibility for it.

words.tr: n. 引人注目的人或物；溅污的斑点；
words.ex: The new singer became a splash on the music scene.
words.ex_cn: 这位新歌手成为了音乐界引人注目的人物。
words.en: To cause (a liquid) to scatter in drops or small quantities, especially by striking or moving suddenly; to move or strike so as to cause a liquid to scatter in this way.

words.ex: She weaves a basket from reeds.
words.ex_cn: 她用芦苇编织一个篮子。
words.en: If you weave cloth or a carpet, you make it by crossing threads over and under each other using a machine or a frame called a loom.

words.tr:
n. （海）鸥；傻子；呆子
v. 欺骗；使上当
words.ex: The gull flew over the sea.
words.ex_cn: 海鸥飞过大海。
words.en: A gull is a common seabird with long wings and white or gray feathers.

words.ex: He writes simple prose every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天写简单的散文。
words.en: Prose is written language in its ordinary form, without metrical structure.

words.ex: Ancient people used flint to make fire.
words.ex_cn: 古人用燧石生火。
words.en: Flint is a very hard greyish-black stone that was used in former times for making tools and weapons, and for starting fires.

words.tr: adj. 考虑周到的；体贴的；
words.ex: He is considerate and always asks if others need help.
words.ex_cn: 他很体贴，总是问别人是否需要帮助。
words.en: Someone who is considerate pays attention to the needs, wishes, or feelings of other people.

words.ex: The police tried to subdue the angry man.
words.ex_cn: 警察试图制服那个愤怒的人。
words.en: To subdue someone or something means to bring them under control by using force or persuasion.

words.tr: n. 扩展；延长期；延伸；电话分机；
words.ex: The company added an extension to its office building.
words.ex_cn: 公司为办公楼加了一个扩建部分。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to make it longer or larger, or the act of adding this part.

words.tr:
n. 陶瓷制品；陶瓷器；
adj. 陶质的；制陶的；
words.ex: He bought a ceramic bowl at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个陶瓷碗。
words.en: Ceramic is a hard material that is made by baking clay or similar substances at high temperatures. It is used to make things such as tiles, dishes, and statues.

words.ex: The reactor produces electricity for the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个反应堆为城市发电。
words.en: A reactor is a device or structure in which nuclear fission or fusion reactions are initiated, controlled, and sustained.

words.ex: He adheres to his principles even when it's hard.
words.ex_cn: 即使很难，他仍然坚持自己的原则。
words.en: If you adhere to a rule or agreement, you act in the way that it says you should.

words.tr: n. 象征物；标志；代金券；代币；
words.ex: The dove is a token of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征物。
words.en: A token is something that represents or stands for something else, especially a piece of metal or plastic that you can use instead of money in some machines or as a symbol of a particular feeling or event.

words.tr: adj. 令人吃惊的； v. “startle”的现在分词；
words.ex: The news was startling to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让所有人都感到吃惊。
words.en: Something that is startling is so surprising, unexpected, or remarkable that it makes you feel slightly shocked.

words.tr:
adj. 极重要的；
n. 紧急的事；
words.ex: It is imperative to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水非常重要。
words.en: If it is imperative that something is done, that thing is extremely important and must be done.

words.tr: v. 设计舞蹈动作；编舞
words.ex: She choreograph the dance for the school play.
words.ex_cn: 她为学校的戏剧设计了舞蹈动作。
words.en: To choreograph is to compose the sequence of steps and movements for a dance or a ballet.

words.ex: This rule is applicable to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: If something is applicable to a particular situation, it is relevant or suitable for that situation.

words.ex: He worked hard and prospered in business.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，在商业上取得了成功。
words.en: If people or businesses prosper, they are successful and do well.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.tr: adj. 要求高的；费力的； v. 需要；“demand”的现在分词；
words.ex: The job is demanding because it needs long hours and high focus.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作要求高，因为它需要长时间工作和高度专注。
words.en: Requiring much effort or attention; exacting.

words.tr: n. 反手击球；向左倾斜的书法
words.ex: She executed a perfect backhand shot.
words.ex_cn: 她完成了一次完美的反手击球。
words.en: A backhand is a stroke made in tennis or other racket sports with the back of the hand facing the direction of the stroke.

words.tr:
n. 倒塌；崩溃；暴跌；
v. 倒塌；崩溃；
words.ex: The collapse of the old bridge caused many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥的倒塌引起了诸多问题。
words.en: If a building or other structure collapses, it falls down very suddenly.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.ex: The radar shows a plane coming near.
words.ex_cn: 雷达显示一架飞机正在靠近。
words.en: A system for detecting the presence, direction, distance, and speed of aircraft, ships, and other objects, by sending out pulses of radio waves which are reflected off the object back to the source.

words.ex: The movie is fascinating because it shows strange aliens.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极有吸引力，因为它展示了奇怪的外星人。
words.en: If you describe something as fascinating, you find it very interesting and attractive, and your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.ex: The enzyme acts as a catalyst in the reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶在反应中充当催化剂。
words.en: A catalyst is a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent chemical change. In a broader sense, it can also refer to a person or thing that precipitates a change.

words.tr: n. 异常事物；反常现象；
words.ex: The strange weather this month is an anomaly.
words.ex_cn: 这个月奇怪的天气是一个异常现象。
words.en: Something that deviates from what is standard, normal, or expected.

words.tr: v. 吞食；吞噬；狼吞虎咽地吃；如饥似渴地看
words.ex: The dog devoured the meat quickly.
words.ex_cn: 狗很快地把肉吃光了。
words.en: To eat something quickly and eagerly, especially because you are very hungry; to destroy something quickly and completely.

words.ex: He sculpted a statue from clay.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏土雕刻了一座雕像。
words.en: To sculpt means to create or represent something by carving, casting, or other shaping techniques.

words.ex: The microscope can magnify small objects.
words.ex_cn: 显微镜可以放大微小的物体。
words.en: To magnify something means to make it appear larger than it is, especially by using a lens or microscope. It can also mean to exaggerate or make something seem more important or serious than it really is.

words.ex: The baby smiled at the sweet melody.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝听到了甜美的旋律，笑了。
words.en: A melody is a sequence of single notes that is musically satisfying.

words.tr:
v. 发射；发起；启动；
n. 发射；投掷；启动；
words.ex: They will launch a rocket tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将发射一枚火箭。
words.en: To launch something means to send it into the air, space, or water, especially with a lot of force or effort, or to start an activity, event, or project.

words.ex: The teacher will formulate a new rule for class.
words.ex_cn: 老师将制定一条新的课堂规则。
words.en: If you formulate something such as a plan or proposal, you invent it, thinking about the details carefully.

words.ex: This movie is a horror genre film.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部恐怖类型影片。
words.en: A genre is a particular type of literature, painting, music, film, or other art form which people consider as a class because it has special characteristics.

words.ex: The sandpaper feels coarse to the touch.
words.ex_cn: 这张砂纸摸起来很粗糙。
words.en: Coarse things have a rough texture because they consist of thick threads or large pieces.

words.tr:
n. 音高；球场；程度（最高点）；宣传论点；
v. 扎营；
words.ex: The singer changed the pitch of her voice.
words.ex_cn: 歌手改变了她声音的音高。
words.en: Pitch can refer to the highness or lowness of a sound, the act of throwing something, or a thick, black, sticky substance used for paving roads or waterproofing.

words.ex: The millennium began in the year 2000.
words.ex_cn: 一千年始于2000年。
words.en: A millennium is a period of one thousand years.

words.tr:
n. 照料；谨慎；关心；
v. 关心；在意；在乎；
words.ex: The nurse gave the baby good care.
words.ex_cn: 护士给了婴儿很好的照料。
words.en: If you care about something, you feel that it is important and are concerned about it.

words.tr: n. 象牙；象牙色 adj. 象牙色的
words.ex: The old piano has ivory keys.
words.ex_cn: 这架旧钢琴有象牙键。
words.en: Ivory is a hard, white material from the tusks and teeth of animals, which is used to make or decorate objects.

words.ex: Running a business entails hard work.
words.ex_cn: 经营企业必然需要努力工作。
words.en: If one thing entails another, it involves it or causes it.

words.ex: She bought a warm wrap for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一件保暖的包裹（披肩）过冬。
words.en: To cover or enclose something in paper, cloth, or other material.

words.tr: n. 紫外线辐射；紫外光；
words.ex: The ultraviolet from the sun can hurt your skin.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的紫外线会伤害你的皮肤。
words.en: Ultraviolet light or radiation has a wavelength shorter than that of visible light but longer than X-rays.

words.ex: The countries formed a peace league.
words.ex_cn: 这些国家组成了一个和平联盟。
words.en: A league is a group of people, countries, or organizations that have joined together for a particular purpose, or because they share a common interest.

words.ex: The letter 'b' is a consonant.
words.ex_cn: 字母 'b' 是一个辅音。
words.en: A consonant is a speech sound that is articulated with complete or partial closure of the vocal tract.

words.tr: adj. 有足够的钱的；富裕的
words.ex: The well-heeled guests arrived in limousines.
words.ex_cn: 富有的客人们乘坐豪华轿车抵达。
words.en: Having plenty of money; wealthy.

words.ex: The computer uses binary code to process data.
words.ex_cn: 计算机使用二进制代码来处理数据。
words.en: Relating to, composed of, or involving two things.

words.tr: v. （使数据）数字化；数字化处理
words.ex: They will digitize old photos next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周会将旧照片数字化。
words.en: To digitize something means to convert it into digital form, so that it can be processed by a computer.

words.ex: He will subdivide the land into two parts.
words.ex_cn: 他将把土地分成两部分。
words.en: If something is subdivided, it is divided into several smaller areas, parts, or sections.

words.ex: The children are vibrant and full of energy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们充满活力。
words.en: If you describe something as vibrant, you mean that it is bright, lively, and full of energy.

words.tr: adj. 可怜的；悲哀的；差劲的；令人生厌的
words.ex: The little dog looked pathetic in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 那只小狗在雨中看起来很可怜。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as pathetic, you mean that they are sad and weak or inadequate, and you feel contempt or pity for them.

words.ex: He tried to agitate the workers to strike.
words.ex_cn: 他试图鼓动工人罢工。
words.en: If you agitate something, you stir it up or shake it. If something agitates you, it makes you feel anxious or upset.

words.ex: He bought a generic brand of painkiller.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一种普通的止痛药品牌。
words.en: Generic refers to something that is not specific or unique, often used to describe products that are not branded or are general in nature.

words.ex: The defiant child refused to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 这个不顺从的孩子拒绝打扫房间。
words.en: If you say that someone is defiant, you mean they show aggression or independence by refusing to obey someone.

words.tr: adj. 平静的；宁静的；温和的；
words.ex: The lake was placid in the morning light.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的阳光下，湖面平静无波。
words.en: A placid person or animal is calm and does not easily become excited, angry, or upset.

words.tr: adj. 黑暗的；幽暗的；忧郁的；沮丧的
words.ex: The room was gloomy with no windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间没有窗户，很黑暗。
words.en: If a place is gloomy, it is almost dark so that you cannot see very well. If people are gloomy, they are unhappy and have no hope.

words.tr: adj. 可触摸的；实际的；有形的；确凿的；
words.ex: The statue is tangible and can be touched.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像可以触摸，是实实在在的。
words.en: Something that is tangible is clear enough or definite enough to be easily seen, felt, or noticed.

words.tr: adj. 按时间先后顺序排列的
words.ex: The events are listed in chronological order.
words.ex_cn: 这些事件按时间顺序列出。
words.en: If things are described or shown in chronological order, they are described or shown in the order in which they happened.

words.tr: adj. 广大的；广阔的；广泛的；大量的；
words.ex: He has extensive knowledge of history.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有广博的历史知识。
words.en: Something that is extensive covers a wide area or includes a lot of things.

words.ex: His rude words provoked her anger.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的话激怒了她。
words.en: If you provoke someone, you deliberately annoy them and try to make them behave aggressively.

words.ex: The company plans to diversify its products.
words.ex_cn: 公司计划使产品多样化。
words.en: To diversify means to make or become more varied or different. It often refers to the process of a company or individual expanding their range of products or activities to reduce risk or to explore new opportunities.

words.ex: Sheep overgraze the land and hurt the grass.
words.ex_cn: 羊群过度放牧，破坏了草地。
words.en: To graze (land) so heavily that the vegetation is damaged and the ground becomes liable to erosion.

words.ex: The detective tried to ascertain the truth.
words.ex_cn: 侦探试图查明真相。
words.en: If you ascertain the truth about something, you find out what it is, especially by making a deliberate effort to do so.

words.tr: n. 标准；尺度；准则；“criterion”的复数；
words.ex: The main criteria for selection are skill and experience.
words.ex_cn: 选择的主要标准是技能和经验。
words.en: A criterion is a standard or principle by which something is judged or decided.

words.tr:
v. 昏厥；对（某人）神魂颠倒
n. 昏厥；狂喜
words.ex: She swooned over the actor's performance.
words.ex_cn: 她对那位演员的表演着迷了。
words.en: If you swoon, you faint or collapse, often because of extreme emotion or heat.

words.tr: n. 历史遗迹；纪念碑；不朽作品；
words.ex: The ancient monument attracts many tourists each year.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代历史遗迹每年吸引许多游客。
words.en: A monument is a large structure, usually made of stone, which is built to remind people of an important person or event.

words.ex: He gave a definite answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了肯定的答案。
words.en: If something is definite, it is firm and clear, and unlikely to be changed.

words.tr:
n. 春天；弹簧；泉；
v. 突然猛烈地移动；跳；
words.ex: Flowers bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天花朵盛开。
words.en: Spring is the season between winter and summer when plants begin to grow again. It is also a device that returns to its original shape after being compressed or stretched, or a natural source of water.

words.ex: He withdrew $100 from the ATM.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动取款机里提取了100美元。
words.en: If you withdraw something from a place, you remove it or take it away.

words.ex: He got a patent for his new invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的新发明获得了专利。
words.en: A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.

words.ex: Milk provides good nourishment for children.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶为儿童提供良好的滋养品。
words.en: Nourishment refers to the food or other substances necessary for growth, health, and good condition.

words.ex: The supplier delivered the boxes on time.
words.ex_cn: 供应商按时送来了箱子。
words.en: A supplier is a person or company that provides goods or services to another person or company.

words.tr: adj. 议会的；国会的；大会的
words.ex: The congressional meeting lasted all day.
words.ex_cn: 国会会议持续了一整天。
words.en: Relating to a congress, especially the United States Congress.

words.ex: Don't interfere when I am working.
words.ex_cn: 我工作时不要打扰。
words.en: To interfere means to involve oneself in a situation where one is not wanted or needed, often causing problems or hindering progress.

words.ex: Each student received their respective book.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都收到了他们各自的书。
words.en: Relating or belonging separately to each of two or more people or things.

words.ex: The project was a monumental task.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目是一项巨大的任务。
words.en: If you describe something as monumental, you are emphasizing that it is very large and impressive, or that it is of great importance or significance.

words.ex: The remnant of the old wall still stands.
words.ex_cn: 这堵旧墙的残余部分仍然矗立着。
words.en: A remnant is a small remaining quantity of something.

words.tr: adj. 外来的；外国来的；奇异的；
words.ex: The market sells exotic fruits from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场出售来自其他国家的外来水果。
words.en: Something that is exotic is unusual and interesting because it comes from or is related to a distant country.

words.ex: He inherited a house from his father.
words.ex_cn: 他从父亲那里继承了一所房子。
words.en: If you inherit something such as a trait, characteristic, or quality, you are born with it, because your parents or ancestors had it. If you inherit money or property, you receive it from someone who has died.

words.ex: The rivalry between the two teams is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这两支队伍之间的竞争非常激烈。
words.en: Competition for the same objective or for superiority in the same field.

words.tr:
v. 抗议；
n. 抗议活动；
words.ex: The students protest against the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 学生们抗议新的校规。
words.en: A protest is the act of saying or showing publicly that you object to something.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.ex: The ancient ritual included a sacrificial offering to the gods.
words.ex_cn: 这个古老仪式包括对神灵的献祭供品。
words.en: Relating to or involving the act of offering something to a deity, especially by killing an animal or person in a religious ceremony.

words.ex: The rebel fought against the king's rules.
words.ex_cn: 这位叛逆者反抗国王的法令。
words.en: A rebel is a person who opposes or fights against people in authority.

words.tr:
n. 垂饰；悬挂物
adj. 吊着的；悬垂的；悬而未决的
words.ex: She wears a silver pendant around her neck.
words.ex_cn: 她戴着一条银色吊坠在脖子上。
words.en: A pendant is a piece of jewelry that hangs from a chain worn around the neck.

words.ex: The tornado destroyed the small house.
words.ex_cn: 龙卷风摧毁了那座小房子。
words.en: A tornado is a violent windstorm characterized by a twisting, funnel-shaped cloud.

words.tr: v. 描述…的特性；以…为特征；
words.ex: This book characterizes the hero as brave and kind.
words.ex_cn: 这本书将主人公描述为勇敢而善良的。
words.en: To describe the character or qualities of someone or something.

words.ex: The audience clapped loudly after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
words.en: The group of spectators at a public event; listeners or viewers collectively, especially those attending a performance or reading a particular work.

words.ex: The cows graze in the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 牛在牧场上吃草。
words.en: Pasture is land covered with grass where animals such as cows and sheep can graze.

words.ex: The Nile River forms a large delta before it flows into the sea.
words.ex_cn: 尼罗河在流入大海之前形成了一个巨大的三角洲。
words.en: A delta is an area of low, flat land shaped like a triangle, where a river splits and spreads out into several branches before entering the sea.

words.ex: He crammed the suitcase with clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服塞满了行李箱。
words.en: If you cram things or people into a place, you put them into it even though there is hardly enough room for them.

words.ex: I wait for the bus at station 15.
words.ex_cn: 我在15号车站等公交车。
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that people can get on or off, or where a particular activity or service is based.

words.ex: The bicycle was a precursor to the car.
words.ex_cn: 自行车是汽车的先驱。
words.en: A precursor is something that happened or existed before another thing, especially if it either developed into it or had an influence on it.

words.ex: Our team won the soccer match.
words.ex_cn: 我们的团队赢得了足球比赛。
words.en: A team is a group of people who play a particular sport or game together against other similar groups of people.

words.tr:
n. 等级；
v. 分等级；
words.ex: He earned a high rank in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他在军队中获得了很高的等级。
words.en: If you rank things or people, you arrange them in order of importance or quality. If someone or something ranks in a particular position, they are in that position on a scale that measures something such as importance or quality.

words.ex: The pond is full of green alga.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里充满了绿色的藻类。
words.en: A simple, nonflowering, and typically aquatic plant of a large group that includes the seaweeds and many single-celled forms. Algae contain chlorophyll but lack true stems, roots, leaves, and vascular tissue.

words.ex: He devised a new way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他设计了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: To devise something means to plan or invent a new way of doing something.

words.ex: He decided to quit smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年决定戒烟。
words.en: If you quit, or quit something, you stop doing it or leave it.

words.ex: The small town is located in the hinterland of the country.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇位于该国的内地。
words.en: The area lying inland from a coast or the shore of a river; the backcountry.

words.tr: v. 有关；把…联系起来；认同；叙述；理解；
words.ex: This story relates to your childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与你的童年有关。
words.en: If you relate a story, you tell it. If two things relate, they are connected in some way.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: He is an expert in the domain of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 他是人工智能领域的专家。
words.en: A domain is a particular field of thought, activity, or interest, especially one over which someone has control, influence, or rights.

words.ex: He gave a stellar performance in the play.
words.ex_cn: 他在剧中表现出色。
words.en: Of or relating to stars; outstanding or excellent.

words.tr: adj. 不可改变的；永恒不变的
words.ex: The password is immutable and cannot be changed.
words.ex_cn: 密码是不可更改的。
words.en: If you say that something is immutable, you mean that it cannot be changed at all.

words.tr:
v. 惊异于；惊异；
n. 令人惊异的人（或事）；
words.ex: I marvel at how fast she runs.
words.ex_cn: 我惊异于她跑得有多快。
words.en: If you marvel at something, you express your great surprise, wonder, or admiration.

words.ex: Some ancient tribes practiced cannibalism in rituals.
words.ex_cn: 一些古代部落在仪式中实行同类相食。
words.en: Cannibalism is the practice of eating the flesh of one's own species.

words.ex: A fraction of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 只有一小部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: A fraction is a small part or amount of something.

words.ex: The word 'cat' has one syllable.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'cat' 有一个音节。
words.en: A syllable is a unit of organization for a sequence of speech sounds. It is typically made up of a syllable nucleus (most often a vowel) with optional initial and final margins (typically, consonants).

words.ex: Farmers grow grain like wheat and rice.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植小麦和大米等谷物。
words.en: A grain is a small, hard seed of a food plant such as wheat, rice, or corn, or the plant itself.

words.ex: The teacher drew a diagram to explain the water cycle.
words.ex_cn: 老师画了一个图表来解释水循环。
words.en: A diagram is a simple drawing which consists mainly of lines and is used, for example, to explain how a machine works.

words.ex: The dog is a scavenger and eats leftover food.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗是拾荒者，吃剩下的食物。
words.en: A scavenger is an animal that feeds on dead organisms, especially a carnivorous animal that eats dead animals rather than or in addition to hunting live prey.

words.ex: A multitude of people attended the festival.
words.ex_cn: 大量的人参加了这个节日。
words.en: A multitude of things or people is a very large number of them.

words.tr: n. 失物招领处（等于 lost property）
words.ex: I found my wallet at the lost-and-found.
words.ex_cn: 我在失物招领处找到了我的钱包。
words.en: A place where lost items are kept until they are claimed by their owners.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.tr:
v. 打破；打断；
n. 休息；中断；破裂；
words.ex: He broke the glass by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打破了玻璃。
words.en: If you break something, you cause it to separate into two or more pieces, often in a way that is irreparable.

words.ex: He imparts knowledge to his students every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天向学生传授知识。
words.en: If you impart information to people, you tell it to them. To impart a particular quality to something means to give it that quality.

words.ex: He was cautious when crossing the busy street.
words.ex_cn: 他过繁忙的街道时很小心。
words.en: If you are cautious, you are careful and avoid taking risks.

words.ex: He needs to substantiate his claim with evidence.
words.ex_cn: 他需要用证据来证实他的说法。
words.en: To substantiate a statement or a story means to supply evidence which proves that it is true.

words.ex: This necklace is precious to her.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链对她来说很珍贵。
words.en: If you say that something such as a resource is precious, you mean that it is valuable and should not be wasted or used badly.

words.tr: n. 企业家；创业者；承包人；
words.ex: He is an entrepreneur who started a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创办了小型咖啡店的企业家。
words.en: An entrepreneur is a person who organizes and operates a business or businesses, taking on greater than normal financial risks in order to do so.

words.tr:
n. 数量；数额；
v. 总计；等于；
words.ex: The amount of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: An amount of something is how much there is of it, or how much you have, need, or get.

words.ex: He steers the team toward success.
words.ex_cn: 他引导团队走向成功。
words.en: To steer a vehicle, ship, or aircraft is to control its direction.

words.ex: He violated the school rule by using his phone in class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课使用手机，违反了校规。
words.en: If someone violates an agreement, law, or promise, they break it.

words.ex: There is a five-minute interval between the two classes.
words.ex_cn: 两节课之间有五分钟的间隔。
words.en: An interval is a period of time between two events or dates.

words.tr: adj. 沉重的；笨重的；沉闷的
words.ex: He carried a ponderous box across the room.
words.ex_cn: 他搬着一个沉重的箱子穿过房间。
words.en: Something that is ponderous is very heavy or is very slow and clumsy because of its weight or size.

words.ex: The teacher define the word 'love' in simple terms.
words.ex_cn: 老师用简单的词给‘爱’下定义。
words.en: If you define something, you show, describe, or state clearly what it is and what its limits are, or what it is like.

words.tr: v. 使可见；使形象化；设想；
words.ex: He uses maps to visualize the data.
words.ex_cn: 他使用地图来使数据可见。
words.en: If you visualize something, you imagine what it is like by forming a mental picture of it.

words.ex: He is frugal with his money.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱很节俭。
words.en: If you describe someone as frugal, you mean that they are careful about spending money and use things only when they need to.

words.ex: She wore a ring with an emerald.
words.ex_cn: 她戴着一枚镶有翡翠的戒指。
words.en: An emerald is a precious stone which is clear and bright green.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.tr: adj. 发声的；嗓音的；直言不讳的；
words.ex: He made a vocal sound to get attention.
words.ex_cn: 他发出声音来引起注意。
words.en: If you are vocal about something, you express your opinions or feelings about it in a strong and public way.

words.ex: He remained passive during the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持被动。
words.en: Accepting or allowing what happens or what others do, without active response or resistance.

words.ex: He tries to eschew sugar for health reasons.
words.ex_cn: 他为了健康尽量避免吃糖。
words.en: If you eschew something, you deliberately avoid doing it or becoming involved in it.

words.ex: He uses deductive reasoning to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他使用演绎推理来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Deductive reasoning is a logical process in which a conclusion is based on the concordance of multiple premises that are generally assumed to be true.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.ex: It is advisable to wear a helmet when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是明智的。
words.en: If something is advisable, it will avoid problems if you do it.

words.tr:
n. 树篱；防范措施
v. 用树篱围住；限制；避免
words.ex: He planted a hedge around his garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园周围种了一排树篱。
words.en: A hedge is a row of bushes or small trees which have been planted along the edge of a garden, field, or road to separate it from another area or to protect it. As a verb, to hedge means to avoid committing oneself or to limit or qualify something by conditions or exceptions.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids for their kings.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人为他们的国王建造了金字塔。
words.en: A pyramid is a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.ex: The teacher exhorts students to study hard.
words.ex_cn: 老师敦促学生努力学习。
words.en: To strongly encourage or try to persuade someone to do something.

words.ex: The two cultures are disparate in their traditions.
words.ex_cn: 这两种文化在传统上完全不同。
words.en: Things that are disparate are clearly different from each other in quality or type.

words.ex: He accepted his homosexuality after years of thinking.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的思考，他接受了自己是同性恋。
words.en: Homosexuality refers to romantic or sexual attraction between members of the same sex.

words.tr: v. 使有生气；使生动活泼
words.ex: The painter uses bright colors to vivify the old mural.
words.ex_cn: 画家用鲜艳的色彩使这幅旧壁画焕发生机。
words.en: To give life or animation to; to enliven.

words.ex: He used a match to ignite the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他用火柴点燃了火。
words.en: If you ignite something or if it ignites, it starts burning or explodes.

words.ex: He spurned the offer because it was too low.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了这个提议，因为报酬太低。
words.en: If you spurn someone or something, you reject them with contempt.

words.tr: v. 连根拔起；迁离；根除；
words.ex: The storm uprooted the old tree.
words.ex_cn: 风暴把那棵老树连根拔起了。
words.en: If you uproot yourself or if you are uprooted, you leave a place where you have lived for a long time and go to live somewhere else.

words.ex: He went back to retrieve his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他回去取回他的钥匙。
words.en: To retrieve something means to get it back from somewhere, especially after it has been lost or taken away.

words.tr:
v. 把…归因于；由…引起；
n. 品质；属性；特征；属性；
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.ex: He made an expeditious decision to leave.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速做出了离开的决定。
words.en: If you describe something as expeditious, you mean that it is done quickly and efficiently.

words.ex: The repetition of the same words made the lesson boring.
words.ex_cn: 相同词语的重复让这堂课变得无聊。
words.en: The act of repeating something that has already been said or written.

words.tr: v. 攻击；困扰；抨击；袭击
words.ex: The storm assailed the small village.
words.ex_cn: 风暴袭击了这个小村庄。
words.en: If someone assails you, they attack you violently, either physically or with words.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；例证；例示
words.ex: This example exemplifies the rule clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这个例子清楚地说明了这条规则。
words.en: To exemplify means to be a typical example of something or to give an example of something.

words.ex: The permanence of the statue reminds us of history.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像的永久性让我们想起历史。
words.en: The state or quality of lasting or remaining unchanged indefinitely.

words.tr:
n. 休息；休会；壁龛；壁凹
v. 放入壁龛；休息；休会
words.ex: The children play outside during recess.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在课间休息时到外面玩耍。
words.en: A recess is a break between the periods of work of an official body such as a committee, a court of law, or a government.

words.tr:
n. 一群；一帮；一伙
v. 成群结队；结成一伙；合伙攻击
words.ex: The gang stole a car last night.
words.ex_cn: 那群人昨晚偷了一辆车。
words.en: A gang is a group of people, especially young people, who go around together and often deliberately cause trouble.

words.tr: adj. 有独创性的；巧妙的；
words.ex: The child came up with an ingenious way to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子想出了一个有独创性的方式来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Something that is ingenious is very clever and involves new ideas, methods, or equipment.

words.ex: Exercise can elevate your mood.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提升你的情绪。
words.en: To elevate something means to raise it to a higher position or level, either physically or in terms of its status or importance.

words.ex: He will replace the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替这把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.ex: He gave the rope a twist to tie it tight.
words.ex_cn: 他把绳子拧了一下以便系紧。
words.en: To twist something means to turn it in a different direction or to change its shape by turning it.

words.tr:
adj. 极度的；
n. 极端；极端的事物；
words.ex: He felt extreme pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后感到极度疼痛。
words.en: If you describe something as extreme, you mean that it is very great in degree or intensity.

words.ex: He is learning the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习英文字母。
words.en: An alphabet is a set of letters or symbols in a fixed order used for writing a language.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.ex: The road was diverted around the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路被改道绕过公园。
words.en: If you divert someone or something, you cause them to change direction or to go somewhere different.

words.ex: The teacher will revoke his privilege to use the computer.
words.ex_cn: 老师将撤销他使用电脑的权限。
words.en: If someone in authority revokes something such as a law, license, or agreement, they cancel it.

words.ex: Melanin is responsible for the color of skin, hair, and eyes.
words.ex_cn: 黑色素决定了皮肤、头发和眼睛的颜色。
words.en: Melanin is a dark pigment found in the skin, hair, and eyes of people and animals, responsible for their color.

words.ex: He is zealous about helping others.
words.ex_cn: 他热心帮助别人。
words.en: If someone is zealous, they are enthusiastic and eager about something, especially something they believe in very strongly.

words.ex: The drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature of something that makes it less useful or desirable than it could be.

words.ex: I am somewhat tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 下班后我有点累。
words.en: You use somewhat to indicate that something is the case to a limited extent or degree.

words.ex: He will perform the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会执行这个任务。
